@aicanvas.description: Two words scramble continuously in a pixel cipher. Hover the container to decrypt them one by one. Mouse out and they snap back to noise. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

@aicanvas.name: scroll-wipe-gallery
@aicanvas.title: Scroll Wipe Gallery
@aicanvas.description: A full-bleed, scroll-driven photo gallery. Each photo wipes in from a different edge. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

@aicanvas.name: signature-pad
@aicanvas.title: Signature Pad
@aicanvas.description: A signature pad widget: pill button morphs into a canvas to draw with mouse or touch. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

@aicanvas.name: slice-type
@aicanvas.title: Slice Type
@aicanvas.description: A typographic magic trick. At rest you read one ambiguous word; hover and it splits into two: LIGHT lifting up, NIGHT sinking down, the shared letters resolving into separate glyphs. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

@aicanvas.name: slide-deck
@aicanvas.title: Slide Deck
@aicanvas.description: Swipeable card deck with four editorial slides. Navigate forward and back by drag or tap. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

@aicanvas.name: sphere-lines
@aicanvas.title: Wireframe Globe
@aicanvas.description: An animated wireframe globe background. A narrow wave band drifts slowly across the surface, and hovering ripples the lines under your cursor. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

@aicanvas.name: stack-tower
@aicanvas.title: Stack Tower
@aicanvas.description: A column of 12 stacked words that reads as a rotating 3D cylinder. 2D transforms skew, scale and shift each row so the rotation travels down the stack. Hover lights one row in warm orange without breaking the rhythm. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

@aicanvas.name: sticker-wall
@aicanvas.title: Sticker Wall
@aicanvas.description: A draggable sticker card wall. Drop notes, toss emoji, pile them up with real 2D physics. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

@aicanvas.name: taga-toggle
@aicanvas.title: Taga Toggle
@aicanvas.description: A playful pill toggle with an expressive face on the thumb: dead (×× eyes, flat mouth) when off, happy (arc eyes, big smile) when on. Track warms from grey to yellow. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

@aicanvas.name: task-cards
@aicanvas.title: Task Cards
@aicanvas.description: A swipeable project task card stack where each card has a unique accent colour, status badge, and due date. Drag left or right to cycle through tasks. The dismissed card springs back to the bottom of the deck. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

@aicanvas.name: text-blur-reveal
@aicanvas.title: Text Blur Reveal
@aicanvas.description: Words animate into view one by one with a satisfying blur-to-sharp entrance, auto-replaying in a loop. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

@aicanvas.name: tilted-coverflow
@aicanvas.title: Tilted Coverflow
@aicanvas.description: 3D coverflow card carousel of seven tilted photos. Drag or arrows to focus any card. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

@aicanvas.name: upload-progress
@aicanvas.title: Upload Progress
@aicanvas.description: A collapsible file upload widget with a shimmer progress bar (indigo while uploading, amber on pause). Expand to see per-file rows with live progress, time remaining, and pause, resume, refresh, and stop controls. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

@aicanvas.name: voice-chat-pill
@aicanvas.title: Live Session Pill
@aicanvas.description: A compact live-session presence pill with an animated speaking indicator and overlapping avatars. Clicks open a soft-UI modal showing all participants with a Join Now button. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

@aicanvas.name: wave-lines
@aicanvas.title: Wave Lines
@aicanvas.description: An animated line background. Dense vertical lines ripple with two layered sine waves, bunching and breathing. Hover to send waves across the canvas. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

@aicanvas.name: wild-morph
@aicanvas.title: Wild Morph
@aicanvas.description: Italic SVG word that warps under the cursor, a spring-physics text animation. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

@aicanvas.name: x-grid
@aicanvas.title: X Grid
@aicanvas.description: An animated X grid background. Marks illuminate and connect to their neighbors with constellation lines as your cursor passes. Free account required to install; source is free to read.

@dotmatrix.description: Two synced 2×3 cells (Unicode dot order) step through clear motifs: rails, full grid, three rows, checker, horseshoes, and alternating columns.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-square-10
@dotmatrix.title: CRT Glide
@dotmatrix.description: A CRT-style horizontal scanline moves down the matrix; swept rows leave a soft phosphor trail with a slight column-wise warp.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-square-11
@dotmatrix.title: Echo Ring
@dotmatrix.description: Concentric diamond ripple with a soft secondary echo pulse per ring.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-square-12
@dotmatrix.title: Origin Wave
@dotmatrix.description: Ripple starts at cell (2,2) and expands outward in concentric rings.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-square-13
@dotmatrix.title: Core Rotor
@dotmatrix.description: Single fan blade rotating around a center hub for a clean, readable loop.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-square-14
@dotmatrix.title: Prism Bloom
@dotmatrix.description: A symmetric kaleidoscope bloom cycling through clean radial motifs.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-square-15
@dotmatrix.title: Helix Glow
@dotmatrix.description: Two mirrored strands with periodic bridges pulse like a compact DNA helix.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-square-16
@dotmatrix.title: Helix Core
@dotmatrix.description: A narrower helix variant that stays in the center band while preserving strand/rung rhythm.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-square-17
@dotmatrix.title: Half Helix
@dotmatrix.description: Single-strand helix variant that shows one side of the DNA wave.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-square-18
@dotmatrix.title: Sound Bars
@dotmatrix.description: Equalizer-style vertical bars that pulse like live music levels.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-square-19
@dotmatrix.title: Infinity Run
@dotmatrix.description: Dual counter-rotating heads trace a figure-eight with a soft crossover pulse at center.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-square-20
@dotmatrix.title: Mobius Run
@dotmatrix.description: A bright head and tail run around the outer ring; a dimmer second train stays half a lap behind, with inner corner flashes for the twist.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-1
@dotmatrix.title: Halo Drift
@dotmatrix.description: A circular-masked half-helix that travels diagonally from top-left to bottom-right with a bright strand and soft adjacent trail.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-2
@dotmatrix.title: Tri Orbit
@dotmatrix.description: Three luminous heads orbit the circular ring at equal offsets, creating a triad chase that never overlaps into the old snake rhythm.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-3
@dotmatrix.title: Plasma Veil
@dotmatrix.description: A plasma-like diagonal sweep and pulsing core weave through the circular mask for a distinctly different motion signature.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-4
@dotmatrix.title: Radar Arc
@dotmatrix.description: A rotating radar arm scans the circular grid with a bright beam front, soft wake, and faint perimeter ring echo.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-5
@dotmatrix.title: Nova Wheel
@dotmatrix.description: Four rotating pinwheel blades spin through the circular matrix with a glowing center and soft trailing halo.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-6
@dotmatrix.title: Phase Orb
@dotmatrix.description: An off-center orbiting energy point traces a phase-shifted loop, creating a drifting orbital glow inside the circular matrix.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-7
@dotmatrix.title: Gate Shift
@dotmatrix.description: A scanning gate flips between vertical and horizontal sweeps, producing a crisp alternating shutter rhythm in the circular grid.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-8
@dotmatrix.title: Heart Pulse
@dotmatrix.description: Pulse bursts from the center with a dual-beat cadence, sending soft concentric pressure waves across the circular matrix.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-9
@dotmatrix.title: Star Compass
@dotmatrix.description: A cardinal beacon pattern: N/E/S/W sectors pulse in sequence with a dim opposite echo, creating a clear directional rhythm in the circular mask.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-10
@dotmatrix.title: Binary Bloom
@dotmatrix.description: Binary-style opacity tiers pulse in modular steps so only a few cells peak at once while others stay low, producing a crisp coded bloom.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-11
@dotmatrix.title: Lunar Breathe
@dotmatrix.description: A rotating crescent moon silhouette: bright lunar body, soft rim, and faint directional halo moving around the circular mask.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-12
@dotmatrix.title: Arc Beacon
@dotmatrix.description: A stepped 8-direction beacon beam sweeps around the circle with a dim opposite echo and diagonal spoke accents.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-13
@dotmatrix.title: Twin Helix
@dotmatrix.description: A circular-masked twin-helix: mirrored side strands weave inward and outward with intermittent interior bridge pulses.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-14
@dotmatrix.title: Rung Shift
@dotmatrix.description: A shifting DNA ladder where a bright horizontal rung steps row-by-row while side anchors sway and leave soft ghost echoes.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-15
@dotmatrix.title: Glyph Cluster
@dotmatrix.description: Braille-inspired grouped dot motifs cycle through rails, bridges, and cross forms inside the circular mask with crisp tiered opacity.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-16
@dotmatrix.title: Rail Scan
@dotmatrix.description: A braille rail scanline sweeps row-by-row between left and right cells, with near-column accents and soft trail falloff.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-17
@dotmatrix.title: Checker Shift
@dotmatrix.description: Braille-biased checker phases alternate in stepped shifts, keeping rails pronounced while the center cross supports readability.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-18
@dotmatrix.title: Pulse Pair
@dotmatrix.description: Mirrored braille dot pairs pulse from top and bottom toward the center, with a connective center-column accent.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-19
@dotmatrix.title: Orbit Cell
@dotmatrix.description: A bright braille cell head orbits the inner ring with a dim tail while rail columns remain softly active.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-circular-20
@dotmatrix.title: Glyph Cycle
@dotmatrix.description: Distinct braille-like glyphs cycle in sequence with previous-frame ghosting for a crisp readable symbol transition.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-1
@dotmatrix.title: Core Spokes
@dotmatrix.description: A triangle-masked matrix where three spoke lines originate at the center and travel outward to each triangle edge.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-2
@dotmatrix.title: Altitude Wave
@dotmatrix.description: A soft altitude wave travels between apex and base while the center column remains gently present for shape readability.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-3
@dotmatrix.title: Corner Bounce
@dotmatrix.description: A single head bounces between triangle corners along the perimeter path with a short fading tail.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-4
@dotmatrix.title: Vertex Chase
@dotmatrix.description: Three staggered heads chase around the triangle perimeter, leaving short fading tails while all dots stay fixed in place.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-5
@dotmatrix.title: Row Sweep
@dotmatrix.description: A reflected scanline sweeps from apex to base and back, animating only opacity bands across triangle rows.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-6
@dotmatrix.title: Braille Beat
@dotmatrix.description: Triangle-masked braille dots fill down the left rail, then the right, then blink full and empty.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-7
@dotmatrix.title: Oblique Weave
@dotmatrix.description: Diagonal harmonics keyed on row + col: bright bands glide along oblique lines through the triangle with a subtle second harmonic for texture.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-8
@dotmatrix.title: Wing Metronome
@dotmatrix.description: The lower triangle splits into left and right wings that trade emphasis on a pendulum beat; apex and center pulse brightest when both sides meet in the middle.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-9
@dotmatrix.title: Corona Tier
@dotmatrix.description: Eight-connected distance rings from the heart cell: a bright corona sweeps outward through discrete tiers then back, so depth reads as concentric energy shells.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-10
@dotmatrix.title: Column Rake
@dotmatrix.description: A stepped head and tail snake the mask in strict column order (bottom to top per column, columns left to right), unlike perimeter chases or diagonal waves.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-11
@dotmatrix.title: Shelf Descent
@dotmatrix.description: Cosine bands keyed on Manhattan distance from the apex (not the center): energy reads as horizontal tiers dropping through the triangle.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-12
@dotmatrix.title: Skew Drift
@dotmatrix.description: Traveling harmonics on `row - col` so bright ridges move along NE–SW obliques, orthogonal in feel to diagonal loaders that use `row + col`.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-13
@dotmatrix.title: Serpent Zip
@dotmatrix.description: A stepped snake follows row-wise serpentine order (base left→right, then alternating row directions) with a long tail — zigzag motion, not a column path.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-14
@dotmatrix.title: Pillar Sweep
@dotmatrix.description: A smooth vertical beam sweeps grid columns 0→6; only triangle-masked dots respond so the silhouette lights one vertical slice at a time.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-15
@dotmatrix.title: Tripod Handoff
@dotmatrix.description: Brightness hands off smoothly among the three silhouette vertices (apex, left base, right base) with Manhattan falloff — a corner-to-corner orbit, not a mod-3 lattice.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-16
@dotmatrix.title: Updraft
@dotmatrix.description: A V-shaped thermal ridge moves through row-and-column space: brightness peaks along an inverted V so the front climbs the two lower flanks toward the apex, not a flat horizontal row scan like Row Sweep.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-17
@dotmatrix.title: Infinity Trace
@dotmatrix.description: A stepped head and tail follow a single 10-cell path: left base up to the apex, down the right rim, then through (4,4) → center → (4,2) for a crossing loop.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-18
@dotmatrix.title: Hollow Shell
@dotmatrix.description: The heart cell stays locked dim while every other triangle dot breathes together in phase — a hollow, ring-like pulse.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-19
@dotmatrix.title: Pivot Ray
@dotmatrix.description: A Gaussian wedge of brightness rotates around the heart cell using each dot’s polar angle — a clear pivoting searchlight, not a cosine-product moiré field.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-triangle-20
@dotmatrix.title: Twin Perimeter
@dotmatrix.description: Two stepped heads chase the outer perimeter path half a lap apart, each with its own tail; the heart cell stays quietly dim off the loop.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-hex-1
@dotmatrix.title: Hex Orbit
@dotmatrix.description: A 3-4-5-4-3 hexagonal dot field with two soft perimeter heads chasing around the shell while the center stays quietly lit.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-hex-2
@dotmatrix.title: Prism Bloom
@dotmatrix.description: Three rotating spokes sweep through the hex field with a soft outer shell pulse and a breathing center point.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-hex-3
@dotmatrix.title: Honey Gate
@dotmatrix.description: Two diagonal bands slide through the honeycomb from opposite sides, meeting in a bright center flash before opening again.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-hex-4
@dotmatrix.title: Vertex Relay
@dotmatrix.description: A bright signal hands off around the hex vertices while inner echo dots answer each corner and the center keeps a quick pulse.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-hex-5
@dotmatrix.title: Spiral Lattice
@dotmatrix.description: Counter-rotating spiral waves cross through the hex lattice, creating a fast core pulse and softer outer wake.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-hex-6
@dotmatrix.title: Chevron March
@dotmatrix.description: Smooth chevron bands flow through the hex field in a wrapped loop, keeping an obvious arrow pattern without a reset snap.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-hex-7
@dotmatrix.title: Hourglass Flip
@dotmatrix.description: Top and bottom bars squeeze into a bright center hourglass, then flip into side rails and a diamond.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-hex-8
@dotmatrix.title: Glyph Flip
@dotmatrix.description: Crisp symbolic masks flip between stars, chevrons, and rails for a snappy pixel-glyph loader.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-hex-9
@dotmatrix.title: Petal Shimmer
@dotmatrix.description: A four-petal highlight rotates through the hex with a soft shell sheen and steady center glow.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-hex-10
@dotmatrix.title: Liquid Vortex
@dotmatrix.description: Refined swirl bands and a slower lens highlight create a smoother liquid shimmer through the hex lattice.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-1
@dotmatrix.title: Square Spiral
@dotmatrix.description: A compact 3×3 grid with a four-dot tail spiraling clockwise from the outer border toward the center.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-2
@dotmatrix.title: Drift TR
@dotmatrix.description: Diagonal bands pulse in sequence across the 3×3 grid from the top-right corner toward the bottom-left.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-3
@dotmatrix.title: Drift TL
@dotmatrix.description: Diagonal bands pulse in sequence across the 3×3 grid from the top-left corner toward the bottom-right.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-4
@dotmatrix.title: Drift BR
@dotmatrix.description: Diagonal bands pulse in sequence across the 3×3 grid from the bottom-right corner toward the top-left.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-5
@dotmatrix.title: Drift BL
@dotmatrix.description: Diagonal bands pulse in sequence across the 3×3 grid from the bottom-left corner toward the top-right.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-6
@dotmatrix.title: Core Echo
@dotmatrix.description: Manhattan rings ripple outward from the center cell, expanding through the 3×3 grid in even steps.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-7
@dotmatrix.title: Column Flux
@dotmatrix.description: Vertical bands pulse in sequence from the left column through the right, lighting all three rows in each column together.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-8
@dotmatrix.title: Row Sweep
@dotmatrix.description: Horizontal bands pulse in sequence from the top row down through the bottom of the 3×3 matrix.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-9
@dotmatrix.title: Serpent
@dotmatrix.description: A narrow pulse travels the full serpentine path across all nine cells, row by row.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-10
@dotmatrix.title: Frame Chase
@dotmatrix.description: A highlight runs clockwise around the outer frame while the center cell holds a steady pulse.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-11
@dotmatrix.title: Glyph Pulse
@dotmatrix.description: Bold symbol motifs flash in sequence — corners, cross, full grid, center, ring, X, and side rails — like a tiny pixel display.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-12
@dotmatrix.title: Drop Ripple
@dotmatrix.description: Concentric ripples expand from the center of the 3×3 grid, like a stone dropped in still water.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-13
@dotmatrix.title: Right Surge
@dotmatrix.description: A vertical wave pulse sweeps from the right column toward the left, illuminating every row in each band together.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-14
@dotmatrix.title: Comet Trail
@dotmatrix.description: A bright comet with a two-dot tail races clockwise around the outer frame while the center cell softly breathes.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-15
@dotmatrix.title: Echo Rings
@dotmatrix.description: Soft square ripples echo outward from the center through Manhattan rings, with a gentle alternating shimmer.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-16
@dotmatrix.title: Smiley Spin
@dotmatrix.description: A pixel smiley face rotates continuously in the 3×3 grid.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-18
@dotmatrix.title: Check Spin
@dotmatrix.description: A pixel checkmark rotates continuously in the 3×3 grid.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-19
@dotmatrix.title: Arrow Spin
@dotmatrix.description: A pixel right arrow rotates continuously in the 3×3 grid.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-20
@dotmatrix.title: Corner Spin
@dotmatrix.description: An L-shaped pixel corner rotates continuously in the 3×3 grid.

@dotmatrix.name: dotm-3x3-21
@dotmatrix.title: Play Spin
@dotmatrix.description: A pixel play triangle rotates continuously in the 3×3 grid.

@ecomcn.name: sort-toolbar

@ecomcn.author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>

@ecomcn.name: empty-results
@ecomcn.title: Empty Results

@ecomcn.author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>

@ecomcn.name: filter-panel
@ecomcn.title: Filter Panel

Compound: one tag for the default layout, or FilterPanelHeader, FilterPanelChips and FilterPanelFacet in any ord
@ecomcn.author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>

@ecomcn.name: filter-sheet
@ecomcn.title: Filter Sheet
@ecomcn.description: The filter panel in a slide-over for small screens. Changes are staged and applied once — on Show or on close — with a live result count on the button and focus returned to the trigger. Accepts the same FilterPanel parts as children, so a custom layout stages too.
@ecomcn.author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>

@ecomcn.name: load-more
@ecomcn.title: Load More
@ecomcn.description: Progressive loading for a product list: a progress rule and “Showing 24 of 312” count, a Load more button, optional hybrid or infinite auto-loading, focus moved to the first new item, and an announced count. The pattern Baymard found performs best, in one component.
@ecomcn.author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>

@ecomcn.name: product-quick-view
@ecomcn.title: Product Quick View
@ecomcn.description: Quick view with a shared-element morph: the card image grows into the dialog and shrinks back on close. @ecomcn.author: ecomcn <hello@ecomcn.dev>

@ecomcn.name: order-summary

@hirael.description: Waitlist form that validates the address, shows a brief loading state, then returns your place in line with an invite link to copy and the referral rewards it unlocks.

@hirael.name: careers-01
@hirael.title: Open Roles List
@hirael.description: Open-roles list with department filter pills and rows that show title, department, location and type, each linking out with a hover arrow.

@hirael.name: careers-02
@hirael.title: Job Posting Page
@hirael.description: Single job posting with the role details, a numbered hiring process and a sticky apply form with CV upload, validation and a success state. On small screens a sticky button jumps to the form.

@hirael.name: hero-09
@hirael.title: Scroll Zoom Hero
@hirael.description: Full-viewport product hero on a rounded card that zooms out as the page scrolls: an inline nav with brand and actions, a serif headline, sub-copy, dual CTAs, a labelled step-type strip, a drifting WebGL gradient mixed from the theme tokens, a bouncing scroll cue and a carved stat

@hirael.name: feature-07
@hirael.title: Problem Framing Cards
@hirael.description: Problem-framing trio: a badge and serif headline with a muted second half above three cards, each an orb icon in concentric rings with a soft radial glow, a title and a short description. Cards fade up in sequence, stilled under reduced motion.

@hirael.name: feature-08
@hirael.title: Spotlight Feature Grid
@hirael.description: Six-card feature grid on hairline rails: each card carries an inline icon beside its title, a title and a description, corner crosshair marks, and a radial spotlight that follows the pointer on hover. Warm-tinted top glow per card.

@hirael.name: feature-09
@hirael.title: Selectable Feature Bento
@hirael.description: Selectable catalog bento on a hairline grid: step cells with a large faded icon, title and description; picking one shows its sample settings in a panel below. Crosshair frames clip at the cell edge.

@hirael.name: feature-10
@hirael.title: Mixed Overview Bento
@hirael.description: Mixed-cell overview bento: a quote with attribution, two metric tiles, a latest-drop card with a CardAction, and a three-job list, all on one hairline lattice.

@hirael.name: feature-11
@hirael.title: Vertical Feature Tabs
@hirael.description: Feature switcher for a shared inbox: a vertical tab list of three capabilities beside a panel previewing each one, from assigned conversations to saved replies and snooze times. Arrow keys move between tabs and the panel follows.

@hirael.name: bento-01
@hirael.title: Developer Platform Bento
@hirael.description: A developer platform bento where a deploy log streams when you press Deploy, region latencies update live, and a 90-day uptime strip, install command and usage chart all respond to input. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: bento-02
@hirael.title: Team Collaboration Bento
@hirael.description: A team collaboration bento with live presence you can follow, a comment thread you can reply to and resolve, a kanban whose cards move by drag or arrows, integration switches and notification settings with a weekly estimate. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: bento-03
@hirael.title: Analytics Bento
@hirael.description: An analytics bento where a range toggle, segment chips and saved reports drive one shared dataset, so the visitor count, funnel and country list always add up.

@hirael.name: bento-04
@hirael.title: Security Compliance Bento
@hirael.description: A security and compliance bento with a live audit trail you can pause, a role permission matrix with save and discard, a 2FA adoption meter, certificate expiry countdowns with renew, and a validated access request form. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: pricing-04
@hirael.title: Featured Glow Pricing
@hirael.description: Three-tier pricing row with a monthly/yearly toggle, an uppercase plan label, a large price with billing note, a tagline, a full-width CTA and a check-marked quota list; the featured tier gets a primary border, a top radial glow and a most-popular badge.

@hirael.name: pricing-05
@hirael.title: Usage Pricing Calculator
@hirael.description: Usage pricing calculator with sliders for active users and build minutes, a priority support switch, and a live monthly estimate broken into line items with a volume tier note and monthly or yearly billing.

@hirael.name: faq-07
@hirael.title: Topic Index FAQ
@hirael.description: Split FAQ: a heading, lead and numbered topic index on the start side; picking a topic opens its answer in the single-open accordion on the end side.

@hirael.name: cta-07
@hirael.title: Glow Border CTA
@hirael.description: Closing CTA panel wrapped in a scroll-reactive primary rim glow that widens as the section moves through the viewport, with an eyebrow badge, a two-tone serif headline, sub-copy and dual CTAs. Static glow under reduced motion.

@hirael.name: hero-10
@hirael.title: Blurred Image Hero
@hirael.description: Bordered hero card over a blurred full-bleed image: a rocket badge, a large centered headline, sub-copy and dual CTAs that rise into place on load. Reduced-motion aware.

@hirael.name: footer-06
@hirael.title: CTA Panel Footer
@hirael.description: Two-part footer: a bordered CTA panel over a rotated, blurred image with a headline, sub-copy and a wide sign-up button, above a brand block with social icons, two link columns and a hairline copyright row.

@hirael.name: footer-05
@hirael.title: Floating Card Footer
@hirael.description: Floating card footer inset from the page edge: a brand block with mark and tagline, three link columns, and a hairline-divided legal row with copyright and a sign-off line.

@hirael.name: status-01
@hirael.title: Uptime Status Page
@hirael.description: Service status page: an operational banner with an inline check, a 90-day uptime grid of tooltip-backed day bars per service with a status legend, and a dated incident history where each update carries a tone-colored badge, a timestamp and a note.

@hirael.name: metric-card
@hirael.title: Metric Card
@hirael.description: Compact metric card with a value and unit, a tone-aware sparkline and an up / down trend line. Compound API.

@hirael.name: yaml-editor
@hirael.title: YAML Editor
@hirael.description: Editable code field with dependency-free YAML syntax highlighting, a line-number gutter and tab-to-indent. Controlled or uncontrolled.

@hirael.name: server-card
@hirael.title: Server Card
@hirael.description: Fleet of host cards, each with a status pill, region, CPU / memory / disk specs and threshold-tinted usage meters. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: vm-table
@hirael.title: VM Table
@hirael.description: Virtual-machine instance table with live status dots, size, region, IP and uptime. Self-contained parts, no table primitive required.

@hirael.name: k8s-pod-table
@hirael.title: Kubernetes Pod Table
@hirael.description: Kubernetes pod table with phase pills (Running, Pending, CrashLoopBackOff), ready and restart counts that flag unhealthy pods.

@hirael.name: resource-status
@hirael.title: Resource Status
@hirael.description: Statuspage-style panel: an overall banner over a list of resources, each with an operational / degraded / outage / maintenance state and uptime.

@hirael.name: cluster-map
@hirael.title: Cluster Map
@hirael.description: Grid heatmap of cluster nodes, each cell tinted by health and load with a hover label, plus a legend. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: network-topology
@hirael.title: Network Topology
@hirael.description: Coordinate-placed topology diagram: nodes with status and icons over an SVG edge layer, with animated active links. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: storage-browser
@hirael.title: Storage Browser
@hirael.description: Object-storage file browser with a clickable path breadcrumb, folder and file rows, sizes and modified dates, and a details row for the selected file. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: log-viewer
@hirael.title: Log Viewer
@hirael.description: Streaming log panel with severity-colored lines, timestamps and sources, a level filter with counts, and a Follow toggle that tails new lines and unpins when you scroll up. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: terminal
@hirael.title: Terminal
@hirael.description: Terminal surface with a title bar, output lines and an interactive prompt input with command-history recall. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: deployment-history
@hirael.title: Deployment History
@hirael.description: Deployment feed on a connecting rail: version, environment and status (deployed, failed, building, rolled back) with commit and author meta.

@hirael.name: kanban
@hirael.title: Kanban
@hirael.description: Board of columns and cards on dnd-kit: pointer and keyboard drag-and-drop across columns, a drag overlay, an empty-column hint, and one commit per move.

@hirael.name: sparkline
@hirael.title: Sparkline
@hirael.description: Tiny inline chart on recharts in line, area or bar form with optional curve, last-point dot, reference line and hover tooltip. Tints with currentColor.

@hirael.name: gauge
@hirael.title: Gauge
@hirael.description: Radial SVG gauge for a single reading on a scale, with threshold bands that recolour the arc, an animated sweep and a centred value and caption. Any start and end angle, from a half circle to a full ring.

@hirael.name: meter
@hirael.title: Meter
@hirael.description: Linear meter for how much of a limit is used, like storage or an API quota, with stacked segments, a legend and thresholds that change the colour. Unlike Progress, which tracks a task, it shows an amount against a limit.

@hirael.name: json-viewer
@hirael.title: JSON Viewer
@hirael.description: Collapsible JSON tree with typed value colors, item counts on closed nodes, long-string truncation, expand or collapse all, copy, and arrow-key navigation.

@hirael.name: diff-viewer
@hirael.title: Diff Viewer
@hirael.description: Line diff of two texts on jsdiff. Unified or split layout, +N / -N stats, context lines with expandable gaps.

@hirael.name: cron-editor
@hirael.title: Cron Editor
@hirael.description: Visual cron builder kept in sync with the raw expression. Presets, per-field modes, validation, a plain-English preview, and the next run times.

@hirael.name: country-select
@hirael.title: Country Select
@hirael.description: Searchable country picker with flag emoji, pinned countries, optional dial codes, and single or multiple selection. Search by name or ISO code.

@hirael.name: command-palette
@hirael.title: Command Palette
@hirael.description: Keyboard-first command menu with a platform shortcut, nested pages, remembered recents and shortcut hints on each row.

@hirael.name: address-input
@hirael.title: Address Input
@hirael.description: Postal address field group that follows the selected country: which fields appear, the order they sit in, and what they are called.

@hirael.name: credit-card-input
@hirael.title: Credit Card Input
@hirael.description: Card number, expiry, and CVC in one row with brand detection, per-brand grouping, Luhn and expiry validation, and auto-advance between fields.

@hirael.name: emoji-picker
@hirael.title: Emoji Picker
@hirael.description: Emoji picker on frimousse: the full emoji set by category, search, skin tones, keyboard navigation and a hover preview.

@hirael.name: avatar-upload
@hirael.title: Avatar Upload
@hirael.description: Click or drop an image, crop it to a circle or square with zoom, and preview the result. Initials fallback, size and type limits, remove control.

@hirael.name: settings-01
@hirael.title: Account Settings Page
@hirael.description: Account settings page with a sticky section nav, card sections with label/control rows that stack on mobile, dirty-aware Save/Cancel footers, and a Danger zone with an alert-dialog confirm. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: settings-02
@hirael.title: Security Settings Tabs
@hirael.description: Security and notifications settings in tabs: change password with strength meter, two-factor toggle, revocable session list, and grouped notification switches under a Pause all master. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: members-01
@hirael.title: Team Members Manager
@hirael.description: Team members management: live search, inline role select, status badges, row actions menu, a pending-invites list with resend/revoke, and an invite dialog that validates emails as tags. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: onboarding-01
@hirael.title: Onboarding Wizard
@hirael.description: Four-step setup wizard on the Stepper: controlled or uncontrolled step, per-step validation gating Continue, Skip, Back, a Finish that fires onComplete, and a fade between steps. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: two-factor-setup-01
@hirael.title: Two-Factor Setup
@hirael.description: Three-step 2FA enrollment card: scan a real otpauth QR or copy the key, confirm a six-digit code, then save recovery codes with copy, download and a checkbox-gated finish. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: coming-soon-01
@hirael.title: Countdown Coming Soon
@hirael.description: Full-viewport launch page with a live countdown, an email notify form that shows an inline success state, and a GitHub link in the footer. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: coming-soon-02
@hirael.title: Sparkle Coming Soon
@hirael.description: Full-viewport launch teaser: a pill badge, a word-by-word serif headline, sub-copy and an email notify form with inline validation and a confirmation, above a glowing horizon of sparkles with a rounded planet edge. Motion respects reduced-motion.

@hirael.name: maintenance-01
@hirael.title: Scheduled Maintenance Page
@hirael.description: Scheduled maintenance page with a pulsing status dot, window card showing start, expected return and migration progress, a notify-me popover with email validation, a status page link and a timestamped updates list. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: maintenance-02
@hirael.title: Offline Maintenance Page
@hirael.description: Full-viewport offline page with a blurred primary glow and a sparkle field behind a pill badge, a word-by-word serif headline, a short status message and a spinner line. Message area is a live region.

@hirael.name: error-01
@hirael.title: Server Error Page
@hirael.description: 500 page with a retry action, home link, collapsible technical details (request id, timestamp, copy button) and a system status line. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: team-01
@hirael.title: Meet the Team
@hirael.description: Team section with a serif headline, a department filter, a grid of members with portraits or initials, roles, bios and GitHub links, and a hiring footer. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: team-02
@hirael.title: Team Profiles with Skills
@hirael.description: Single-profile experience section: a four-up metric strip, a bio card with a grid-pattern backdrop, and a competencies card that ends in three pause-on-hover marquee rows of skill chips with edge fades. Every element rises in on scroll and respects reduced-motion.

@hirael.name: team-03
@hirael.title: Distributed Team Directory
@hirael.description: Distributed team directory grouped by department, showing each person’s live local time and whether they are inside working hours, with a department filter and a sort by time zone.

@hirael.name: stats-01
@hirael.title: Count Up Stats
@hirael.description: Metrics band with four large numbers that count up on scroll, labels, optional deltas, and a two-column header on large screens. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: stats-02
@hirael.title: Stats with Sparklines
@hirael.description: Four metric tiles with a 4w, 12w or 52w range toggle that swaps each figure, trend chip and sparkline; one metric trends the wrong way.

@hirael.name: stats-03
@hirael.title: Stats with Targets
@hirael.description: Split stats section: a short growth story on one side, four metrics tracked against their targets on the other. Bars fill from zero on load and a Quarter / Year toggle swaps the figures.

@hirael.name: cookie-consent
@hirael.title: Cookie Consent
@hirael.description: Floating consent banner with per-category switches, accept, reject, and save actions, and a choice persisted in localStorage. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: changelog-01
@hirael.title: Changelog Timeline
@hirael.description: Release notes with a sticky date rail, version badges, New / Improved / Fixed tags, a subscribe button, and a filter that narrows entries. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: changelog-02
@hirael.title: Public Roadmap Board
@hirael.description: Public roadmap board with Now, Next and Later columns. Every item can be upvoted, the board sorts by votes or by date, and on small screens tabs pick the column.

@hirael.name: not-found-02
@hirael.title: Framed 404 Page
@hirael.description: A 404 page framed by side rails, with a photo, an error code, a home link and a band of popular pages. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: page-header-01
@hirael.title: Detail Page Header
@hirael.description: Detail page header with a breadcrumb that collapses on small screens, a status badge, owner and contributor meta, and Share, Edit and overflow actions. Share copies the link, Edit renames in place, Archive locks the page until restored and Delete can be undone. Ships composable p

@hirael.name: page-header-02
@hirael.title: Tabbed Page Header
@hirael.description: Workspace header with a primary action and line tabs for Overview, Members, Billing and Settings, kept in sync with the URL hash. Inviting someone updates the member count and the billing total, and renaming the workspace updates the title. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: page-header-03
@hirael.title: Filter Toolbar Page Header
@hirael.description: Invoice list header with a live count, a New invoice dialog and a toolbar for search, status filter, sort and list or grid layout. Shows an empty result with Clear filters when nothing matches. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: page-header-04
@hirael.title: Analytics Page Header
@hirael.description: Analytics header with a 7, 30 or 90 day range and CSV export, above a strip of four metrics with animated values, sparklines and change chips colored by whether the change is good or bad. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: empty-state-01
@hirael.title: First-Run Empty State
@hirael.description: A first-run projects panel. Create a project with a validated name or import a GitHub repo, and the list replaces the empty state.

@hirael.name: empty-state-02
@hirael.title: No Results Empty State
@hirael.description: A customer list with search and plan and status filters. When nothing matches, it repeats the query, says how many matches the filters hide, suggests close matches and offers to clear filters.

@hirael.name: empty-state-03
@hirael.title: Load Error Empty State
@hirael.description: A deployments panel that failed to load, with a copyable error reference and a support link. Try again shows loading rows, fails once more, then loads the data.

@hirael.name: empty-state-04
@hirael.title: Invite Members Empty State
@hirael.description: A members panel with an invite form inside the empty state. Invites are validated and listed as pending, and revoking the last one brings the empty state back.

@hirael.name: search-01
@hirael.title: Faceted Docs Search
@hirael.description: Docs search with type, product area and date facets whose counts reflect the other active filters, removable filter chips and relevance or newest sorting. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: search-02
@hirael.title: Search Suggestions Dropdown
@hirael.description: Search field with a suggestion dropdown: recent and popular searches when empty, matching pages and people while typing. Slash focuses it and the arrow keys move through results.

@hirael.name: search-03
@hirael.title: Search Results Page
@hirael.description: Search results page with type tabs and counts, results laid out for docs, people and files, a spelling correction when nothing matches, and paged loading.

@hirael.name: search-04
@hirael.title: Help Center Search
@hirael.description: Help center search section with popular topics that fill the query, live matching articles as you type, and a category index when the field is empty.

@hirael.name: survey-01
@hirael.title: NPS Survey
@hirael.description: NPS card built on Questionnaire: a 0 to 10 scale with number-key shortcuts, then a required follow-up question that changes with the score. Submitting shows the score with a Change answer action. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: survey-02
@hirael.title: Feedback Survey
@hirael.description: Four-question feedback card built on the Questionnaire: single choice, pick up to 3, a 1 to 5 rating and an optional comment you can skip. Required questions validate inline, and a review step lets you edit any answer before submitting.

@hirael.name: survey-03
@hirael.title: Cancellation Survey
@hirael.description: Plan card with a cancellation survey in a dialog, built on Questionnaire. The reason you pick decides the follow-up step (a discount, a pause or a feedback question), and the card shows the result with an undo.

@hirael.name: survey-04
@hirael.title: Conversational Survey
@hirael.description: Full-height survey that shows one question per screen, with letter-key answers, Enter to continue and a thin progress bar. One answer skips a later question, and the flow ends on a personal thank-you with a restart.

@hirael.name: chart-01
@hirael.title: Revenue Bar Chart
@hirael.description: Monthly revenue bar chart by plan with a year select, a stacked or grouped toggle, totals above the bars and a summary line computed from the data.

@hirael.name: chart-02
@hirael.title: Traffic Area Chart
@hirael.description: Traffic area charts for visitors and signups with a 7, 30 or 90 day range, legend cards that turn each series on or off, and a crosshair tooltip shared across both panels.

@hirael.name: chart-03
@hirael.title: Channel Donut Chart
@hirael.description: Revenue by channel donut with the total in the centre and a ranked list of value, share and change. Hovering a row highlights its slice and hovering a slice highlights its row.

@hirael.name: chart-04
@hirael.title: Conversion Funnel Chart
@hirael.description: Signup funnel from visited to subscribed, showing the count, share of visitors, step conversion and drop-off at each step, with an All, Organic or Paid segment toggle.

@hirael.name: chat-01
@hirael.title: Two-Pane Messenger
@hirael.description: Messenger with a searchable conversation list, unread counts that clear when opened, and a thread that sticks to the newest message, with attachments and an emoji picker in the composer. On phones the list and thread become two screens. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: chat-02
@hirael.title: Support Chat Widget
@hirael.description: Floating support widget with the typical reply time, quick replies, an agent that answers a few topics after a typing indicator, and a rating when the conversation ends. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: chat-03
@hirael.title: Team Channel with Threads
@hirael.description: Team channel with emoji reactions, a pinned message, @mentions in the composer, and replies that open in a side thread with its own composer. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: chat-04
@hirael.title: Shared Inbox
@hirael.description: Shared customer inbox with Open, Snoozed and Closed tabs, an assignee filter, internal notes in the composer, saved replies, and snooze and close actions that move conversations between tabs. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: env-editor
@hirael.title: Env Variables Editor
@hirael.description: Environment variables editor with masked secrets, copy, per-environment chips, .env import, key validation, and unsaved-change tracking. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: prompt-input
@hirael.title: Prompt Input
@hirael.description: Chat composer with an auto-growing textarea, Enter to send, attachments, a model picker, and a Stop button while streaming. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: message-thread
@hirael.title: Message Thread
@hirael.description: Message list that follows streaming output, with tool calls, reasoning, sources, hover actions, typing dots, and a streaming cursor. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: ai-chat-01
@hirael.title: AI Chat with History
@hirael.description: Full chat screen: grouped history sidebar that collapses to a sheet, top bar with model badge, streaming thread, and pinned composer. Ships composable parts.

@hirael.name: accordion
@hirael.title: Accordion
@hirael.description: Radix-powered accordion primitive used by the FAQ blocks. Plus icon rotates to an X on open.

@hirael.name: compose-refs
@hirael.title: Compose Refs
@hirael.description: Fans one node out to several refs, so a part can keep its own internal ref while still forwarding the element to the consumer.

@hirael.name: theme-emerald
@hirael.title: Emerald theme
@hirael.description: Emerald accent preset for the hirael palette. Sets --primary, --primary-foreground and --ring for light and dark.

@morphiq.name: prism-glass
@morphiq.title: Prism Glass
@morphiq.description: A GPU-accelerated refractive lens for images and rendered textures. Spectral dispersion, uniform frost and a directional rim light, from an SDF-defined shape — no 3D model required. It refracts the texture you give it, not the DOM behind it.

@morphiq.name: dock
@morphiq.title: Magnifying Dock
@morphiq.description: A dock whose items swell as the pointer nears, on springs. Distance drives the scale, so the row breathes rather than one icon popping.

@morphiq.name: ferrofluid-nav
@morphiq.title: Ferrofluid Nav
@morphiq.description: A nav whose active pill stretches out of one item, thins to a neck and gathers into the next. Two capsule fields blended with a polynomial smooth-minimum, evaluated per pixel — the neck is surface tension, not a translate.

@morphiq.name: elastic-headline
@morphiq.title: Elastic Headline
@morphiq.description: A headline strung on an elastic. Letters are nodes on a mass-spring chain pinned at both ends and coupled by the discrete Laplacian, so a pull travels outward and reflects off the ends — grab one and the whole line deforms, then rings out.

@morphiq.name: pressure-text
@morphiq.title: Pressure Text
@morphiq.description: Type that reacts to the cursor. Letters thicken and widen under the pointer while their neighbours give up the space, so the word keeps its overall width. Both axes are synthesised from a single cut, so it morphs rather than cross-dissolving between weights.

@morphiq.name: scroll-expand
@morphiq.title: Scroll Expand
@morphiq.description: A framed panel pinned to the viewport that opens out to full bleed as you scroll past it, with the media inside settling back from a slight push-in. Progress is published as two CSS custom properties, so anything you drop inside can join the animation with one line of CSS.

@morphiq.name: ascii-field
@morphiq.title: ASCII Field
@morphiq.description: A canvas field of glyphs that scramble around the cursor and settle back to rest.

@morphiq.name: bitmap-noise
@morphiq.title: Bitmap Noise
@morphiq.description: A self-generating dither field. Two drifting noise layers interfere to form patches of particles that appear, dissolve and reform in place. Canvas 2D, no WebGL.

@morphiq.name: bitmap-image
@morphiq.title: Bitmap Image
@morphiq.description: Converts an image into a dithered bitmap — ordered Bayer or true error diffusion (Floyd-Steinberg, Atkinson, Jarvis), which no shader can do. Canvas 2D, no WebGL.

@morphiq.name: bitmap-text
@morphiq.title: Bitmap Text
@morphiq.description: Type rasterised and dithered into particles. A grain control decides whether the letterforms read as solid or as a cloud that still resolves as words. Canvas 2D, no WebGL.

@morphiq.name: weight-grid
@morphiq.title: Weight Grid
@morphiq.description: A bento grid where the cell under the cursor takes area from its neighbours and the total never changes. Track weights are renormalised against their axis sum, so growing a cell is taking space off the ones beside it — not growing the grid.

@morphiq.name: smear-cursor
@morphiq.title: Smear Cursor
@morphiq.description: A cursor trail that is motion blur rather than a string of dots. Ribbon width falls as 1/(1+speed·k), the way a camera spreads the same exposure over more ground the faster the subject moves.

@morphiq.name: sonar-list
@morphiq.title: Sonar List
@morphiq.description: A ping leaves the click and sweeps outward; each row rings as the wavefront reaches it. Arrival is d/c, a real propagation time, so rows near the click ring first whatever their index — and each row is its own damped oscillator, evaluated in closed form.

@morphiq.name: thrown-marquee
@morphiq.title: Thrown Marquee
@morphiq.description: A marquee you can grab and throw. Velocity decays exponentially toward the idle drift rather than toward zero, so a hard throw drops fast then creeps and the band returns to its resting speed with no special case.

@morphiq.name: thread-pull
@morphiq.title: Thread Pull
@morphiq.description: A thread strung under a line of text that hangs in a real catenary when you pull it. Length is conserved, so dragging to one side starves that segment and floods the other; the parameter is solved by Newton each frame.

@morphiq.name: magnetic-field
@morphiq.title: Magnetic Field
@morphiq.description: Iron filings aligning to a dipole under the cursor. B proportional to (3(m·r̂)r̂ − m)/r³, so the pattern has two lobes and the loops between them — a radial fan has neither.

@morphiq.name: depth-of-field
@morphiq.title: Depth of Field
@morphiq.description: A card stack blurred by a real circle of confusion, so the near side defocuses harder than the far side — the asymmetry that makes a photograph read as one. The focal plane racks with the pointer.

@morphiq.name: folding-panel
@morphiq.title: Folding Panel
@morphiq.description: A panel that folds along real crease lines. Facets are placed by walking the fold outward so the paper stays connected, the panel foreshortens by cos θ as it closes, and each facet shades by Lambert's cosine law from its own normal.

@morphiq.name: elastic-rail
@morphiq.title: Elastic Rail
@morphiq.description: A scroll progress rail that bulges with overscroll and twangs back. It obeys the wave equation, so its pitch follows f = (1/2L)·√(T/μ) — a longer rail rings lower, with nothing tuned per page.

@morphiq.name: gravity-menu
@morphiq.title: Gravity Menu
@morphiq.description: Menu items on stable orbits, bent past the pointer by a softened inverse-square attraction. The softening term is what stops an item crossing the cursor being flung off screen in a single frame.

@oidc.name: core
@oidc.title: OIDC Core
@oidc.description: A starter policy form: GitHub Actions and Vercel behind a toggle picker, each form with its own submit. The file is yours — add providers, swap the picker, and wire onSubmit to your storage. The builder at the homepage generates this file for any provider combination.

@oidc.name: claims
@oidc.title: OIDC Claims Pieces
@oidc.description: The shared pieces every provider form composes: the ClaimsList row editor for additional claims, the ClaimChip label marker, and the pure helpers that merge rows into a policy and read them back out.

@oidc.name: picker
@oidc.title: OIDC Picker
@oidc.description: Single-select provider picker that adapts to the count: a toggle row for up to three providers, a select beyond that, nothing for one.

@oidc.name: page-actions
@oidc.title: OIDC Settings Page
@oidc.description: A working settings page: app/settings/oidc renders the policy form, and a server action validates with validateOidcPolicy before saving. Wire the form's onSubmit to savePolicy and replace the console.log with your storage.
