@reactframe.description: An agent-style AI answer card, a researching/reading/writing step tracker with a progress rail, markdown-style bold and bullet text, clickable inline citations, source cards, follow-up questions, and custom/sunset themes.

@reactframe.name: ai-edit-review
@reactframe.title: AI Edit Review
@reactframe.description: An AI text editor that rewrites a selected passage, streams a word-level diff review with accept/reject actions, and morphs a dock through writing, review, and applied states.

@reactframe.name: video-glow-lightbox
@reactframe.title: Video Glow Lightbox
@reactframe.description: A single video card with a pulsing glow-blob frame that morphs into a fullscreen lightbox on click, supports direct URL, YouTube, Vimeo, or uploaded files, a cursor-following watch label, hover preview loop, and a Web Audio sound-reactive glow.

@reactframe.name: glide-carousel
@reactframe.title: Glide Carousel
@reactframe.description: A canvas-rendered, drag-to-scroll carousel with a curved wave layout and ambient wind/drift/magnetic card sway, click-to-open lightbox modal, autoplay, and image/video support.

@reactframe.name: testimonial-logos
@reactframe.title: Testimonial Logos
@reactframe.description: A compact trust bar, a star rating with a helped-N-teams label above an infinite, edge-masked logo marquee.

@reactframe.name: dice-discount-popup
@reactframe.title: Dice Discount Popup
@reactframe.description: A gamified discount popup, roll two animated 3D dice for a reward tier (with a doubles bonus), copy the code, and track rolls left across a session. Inline or corner-widget popup with manual, delay or scroll triggers.

@reactframe.name: scratch-card-popup
@reactframe.title: Scratch Card Popup
@reactframe.description: A gamified scratch-to-win popup, drag to scratch a gold-foil canvas off a 3x3 icon grid, match three to win a reward tier with a confetti burst, copy the code, and track attempts left. Inline or corner-widget popup with manual, delay or scroll triggers.

@reactframe.name: business-hours
@reactframe.title: Business Hours
@reactframe.description: A premium opening-hours card, live open/closed status with a pulsing dot, a day-by-day schedule, and a Get Directions link built from an address or custom URL.

@reactframe.name: motion-gallery-grid
@reactframe.title: Motion Gallery Grid
@reactframe.description: A perfectly aligned image grid with a centered glassmorphism overlay card, heading, subtitle and CTA button, with a staggered blur/slide/fade/scale entrance triggered on scroll into view.

@reactframe.name: qr-code-widget
@reactframe.title: QR Code Widget
@reactframe.description: A QR-code card, title, description, code image, hint text and an open-link button, inline or as a corner-widget popup with a focus-trapped modal dialog.

@reactframe.name: airbnb-reviews
@reactframe.title: Airbnb Reviews
@reactframe.description: A guest-review carousel with the Airbnb Bélo mark, aggregate rating header and CTA, above a draggable autoplaying grid of review cards.

@reactframe.name: ebay-reviews
@reactframe.title: eBay Reviews
@reactframe.description: A seller-feedback carousel with the eBay wordmark, aggregate rating header and CTA, above a draggable autoplaying grid of review cards.

@reactframe.name: etsy-reviews
@reactframe.title: Etsy Reviews
@reactframe.description: A shop-review carousel with the Etsy wordmark, aggregate rating header and CTA, above a draggable autoplaying grid of review cards.

@reactframe.name: coin-flip-game
@reactframe.title: Coin Flip Game
@reactframe.description: A real 3D CSS coin, click or tap to flip with a physical spin animation, a yes/no question field, flip history dots, and a heads/tails ratio readout.

@reactframe.name: tic-tac-toe-game
@reactframe.title: Tic Tac Toe Game
@reactframe.description: A playable Tic Tac Toe board with a built-in AI opponent, animated piece placement, a drawn winning-line reveal, score tracking, and a confetti burst on a win.

@reactframe.name: 2048-game
@reactframe.title: 2048 Game
@reactframe.description: A fully playable 2048, arrow-key and swipe controls, spring-animated tile merges, score and best-score tracking, and win/game-over overlays.

@reactframe.name: snake-game
@reactframe.title: Snake Game
@reactframe.description: A canvas-rendered Snake game with three difficulty speeds, keyboard and swipe controls, a directional-eyes snake head, high-score tracking, and ready/game-over overlays.

@reactframe.name: minesweeper-game
@reactframe.title: Minesweeper Game
@reactframe.description: A classic Minesweeper with three board sizes, flood-fill reveal, right-click flagging, a live mine counter and timer, and a confetti burst on a win.

@reactframe.name: memory-match-game
@reactframe.title: Memory Match Game
@reactframe.description: A flip-card memory matching game with animal emoji, three difficulty levels, a 3D flip animation, move/score tracking, and a win overlay.

@reactframe.name: pong-game
@reactframe.title: Pong Game
@reactframe.description: A canvas Pong against a bot opponent, three difficulty levels, multi-round progression with a color shift and speed increase each round, keyboard and touch-drag paddle control.

@reactframe.name: dino-runner-game
@reactframe.title: Dino Runner Game
@reactframe.description: A canvas endless-runner in the style of the offline dino game, pixel-drawn running dino, procedurally spawned cactus obstacles, three difficulty speeds, tap/space/arrow-up to jump, and a high-score tracker.

@reactframe.name: space-invaders-game
@reactframe.title: Space Invaders Game
@reactframe.description: A canvas Space Invaders, a descending grid of pixel-drawn invaders that shoot back, three difficulty levels, keyboard controls on desktop and on-screen move/fire buttons on mobile, with a win/lose end screen.

@reactframe.name: glow-jump-widget
@reactframe.title: Glow Jump Widget
@reactframe.description: A floating-action-button popup that opens a glowing 4-level platformer, jump between walls, dodge moving lava, and collect coins to finish each level, keyboard and on-screen touch controls included.

@reactframe.name: spin-to-win-wheel
@reactframe.title: Spin to Win Wheel
@reactframe.description: A gamified discount-capture widget where visitors spin a weighted SVG prize wheel for a reward, with five glass themes, a themed reveal modal and code copy, rendered inline or as a corner-launched popup with manual/delay/scroll triggers.

@reactframe.name: memory-cards-widget
@reactframe.title: Memory Cards Widget
@reactframe.description: A floating-action-button popup that opens a color-matching memory game, 3 difficulty levels, a live timer/move counter, best-score tracking, subtle Web Audio sound effects, and a confetti win screen.

@reactframe.name: bubble-cursor
@reactframe.title: Bubble Cursor
@reactframe.description: A liquid-glass bubble that follows the pointer across the whole page, rendered with a raymarched WebGL2 metaball trail with fresnel shading and iridescent glints, plus an optional light/dark theme toggle.

@reactframe.name: review-card-portrait
@reactframe.title: Review Card Portrait
@reactframe.description: A portrait-format testimonial card with a crossfading top image strip, counter, thumbnail selector, and an animated quote with name/role, plus prev/next navigation and optional autoplay.

@reactframe.name: cinematic-stacked-gallery
@reactframe.title: Cinematic Stacked Gallery
@reactframe.description: A fullscreen hero gallery where inactive slides collapse into a stacked deck of thumbnails; clicking one crossfades it to full size with Ken Burns zoom, cursor parallax, and a title/description rail with CTA and prev/next controls.

@reactframe.name: dice-roll-discount-popup
@reactframe.title: Dice Roll Discount Popup
@reactframe.description: A gamified discount-capture widget where visitors roll two 3D dice for a reward tier, with a themed reveal modal and code copy, rendered inline or as a corner-launched popup with manual/delay/scroll triggers.

@reactframe.name: error-404-page-section
@reactframe.title: 404 Page Section
@reactframe.description: A centered "page not found" section: a big glitching error code, heading, description and one or two pill buttons. Follows the host site's theme by default (or a fixed dark / light palette with an optional theme toggle) and scales with its own width.

@reactframe.name: toast-stack
@reactframe.title: Toast Stack
@reactframe.description: A stacked toast notification system: toasts pile up in a layered stack that fans out on hover, with six tones including a loading state that turns into a result, auto-dismiss that pauses on hover, swipe to dismiss and an action button.

@reactframe.name: notification-center
@reactframe.title: Notification Center
@reactframe.description: A bell button with an unread badge that opens a notification panel: All and Unread tabs, Today and Earlier groups, unread dots, mark as read on click, mark all as read, per-item remove and full keyboard support.

@reactframe.name: status-dot
@reactframe.title: Status Dot
@reactframe.description: A presence and status indicator: online, away, busy, offline and live dots with an optional label, a pulsing ring for live states, and a pinned mode that sits on an avatar's corner behind a cut-out ring.

@reactframe.name: inline-validation-message
@reactframe.title: Inline Validation Message
@reactframe.description: A field-level validation message with error, warning, success and info states: it slides open under the field, crossfades when the text changes, shakes once when an error appears, and lives in a live region so screen readers announce it.

@reactframe.name: dropdown-menu
@reactframe.title: Dropdown Menu
@reactframe.description: A button-triggered menu with icons, keyboard shortcuts, checkbox and radio items, labelled sections, nested submenus and a highlight that slides from row to row, with full keyboard support including typeahead.

@reactframe.name: mega-menu
@reactframe.title: Mega Menu
@reactframe.description: A pill navigation bar whose menus open one shared panel: it morphs to each menu's size, slides the content in from the side you moved to, and holds columns of icon links plus a featured card, with hover intent and keyboard support.

@reactframe.name: mobile-tab-bar
@reactframe.title: Mobile Tab Bar
@reactframe.description: A bottom navigation bar for phones: a pill slides behind the active tab and its icon bounces, with badge counts, an optional raised centre action, docked or floating styles, blurred glass and safe-area padding.

@reactframe.name: table-of-contents
@reactframe.title: Table of Contents
@reactframe.description: An 'On this page' table of contents for articles and docs: it tracks the section in view, slides a marker along its rail (filling it like reading progress), indents subsections, and smooth-scrolls to a heading on click. Collects headings automatically.

@reactframe.name: scrollspy-anchor-links
@reactframe.title: Scrollspy Anchor Links
@reactframe.description: A sticky horizontal bar of section links (Overview, Features, Specs, Reviews) that follows the section in view with a sliding pill or underline, keeps the current link scrolled into view on phones, and fills a progress line as you read.

@reactframe.name: language-switcher
@reactframe.title: Language Switcher
@reactframe.description: A language picker: a globe button whose name rolls to the new language, opening a searchable list of native names with codes and a check on the current one, or a segmented row of codes for two to four languages.

@reactframe.name: checkbox-group
@reactframe.title: Checkbox Group
@reactframe.description: A group of checkboxes with a Select all row that shows a dash when only some are picked, checks that draw themselves, list or card layouts, a maximum that disables the rest, a live count and an error state.

@reactframe.name: bottom-sheet
@reactframe.title: Bottom Sheet
@reactframe.description: A mobile bottom sheet that slides up over a dimmed backdrop, rests at snap points you drag between from its handle, closes on a downward flick, and keeps its own content scrollable.

@reactframe.name: lightbox
@reactframe.title: Lightbox
@reactframe.description: An image lightbox for any grid of photos: the thumbnail morphs into the full view, then arrows, keys and swipes step through, double-click zooms and pans, a swipe down closes, and a thumbnail strip tracks where you are.

@reactframe.name: cookie-consent-banner
@reactframe.title: Cookie Consent Banner
@reactframe.description: A cookie consent banner as a corner card or a bottom bar: accept all, reject all with equal weight, or open per-category switches (necessary locked on), and the choice is remembered, with a small button to change it later.

@reactframe.name: product-tour
@reactframe.title: Product Tour
@reactframe.description: A guided product tour: a spotlight glides from element to element over a dimmed page while a card beside it explains each one, with progress dots, Back, Next and Skip, arrow keys, and automatic placement on the side that has room.

@reactframe.name: calendar
@reactframe.title: Calendar
@reactframe.description: An inline month calendar for picking one day, a range or several days, with event dots under their days, an agenda for the selected day, months that slide in from the side they come from, a month picker, week numbers and full keyboard control.

@reactframe.name: basic-carousel
@reactframe.title: Basic Carousel
@reactframe.description: A plain, dependable carousel: drag or swipe between slides, arrows and dots, one to four slides in view, looping, and optional autoplay whose progress fills the active dot and pauses whenever someone hovers, focuses or drags.

@reactframe.name: sparkline-stat
@reactframe.title: Sparkline Stat
@reactframe.description: A KPI card with a sparkline: the number counts to its new value, a change badge says how far it moved, range tabs swap the series with a redraw, and scrubbing the chart turns the headline into that point's value.

@reactframe.name: checklist
@reactframe.title: Checklist
@reactframe.description: An onboarding checklist: a progress bar and count up top, round checks that draw in and strike the step through, the next step opening by itself with its own action button, a fold-away header and an all-done state.

@reactframe.name: icon-list
@reactframe.title: Icon List
@reactframe.description: A list with an icon on every line for features, benefits and what's included: checks that draw themselves in as the rows fade up, dimmed and struck-through lines for what isn't included, optional descriptions, and one or two columns.

@reactframe.name: icon-box
@reactframe.title: Icon Box
@reactframe.description: A feature box with an icon, title and text for features and services grids: in the card style a light follows the pointer along the border, the icon tile lifts and tilts on hover, and a linked box nudges its arrow forward.

@reactframe.name: data-view
@reactframe.title: Data View
@reactframe.description: A collection view that switches between a card grid and a list, with every item gliding to its new place; a sort menu reorders them with the same motion, and a pager steps through pages.

@reactframe.name: sortable-list
@reactframe.title: Sortable List
@reactframe.description: A list people can put in their own order: drag a row by its handle and the others slide out of the way, or use the keyboard (Space to lift, arrows to move, Space to drop, Escape to undo), with live position numbers and optional remove buttons.

@reactframe.name: organization-chart
@reactframe.title: Organization Chart
@reactframe.description: An org chart of people cards joined by rounded connector lines: teams open and close from a count chip under each manager, and picking someone lights up their reporting line all the way to the top.

@reactframe.name: transfer-list
@reactframe.title: Transfer List
@reactframe.description: Two lists side by side for moving items from one set to another, such as available and granted permissions: tick items and send them across with the arrows (or double-click one), move everything at once, search each side, and watch rows glide between the lists.

@reactframe.name: tree-table
@reactframe.title: Tree Table
@reactframe.description: A table whose rows nest, like files in folders: open and close branches with a chevron, parents add up their children (folder sizes), sort any column with folders kept on top, and tick rows with checkboxes that select whole branches.

@reactframe.name: chat-bubble
@reactframe.title: Chat Bubble
@reactframe.description: Chat message bubbles for both sides of a conversation: runs from the same person group together with tight inner corners and one avatar, outgoing messages show sending, delivered and read ticks, reactions pop in under a bubble, and a typing bubble bounces while someone writes.

@reactframe.name: list-group
@reactframe.title: List Group
@reactframe.description: A framed group of rows for settings menus and navigation lists: icons, descriptions, count badges, a danger row for destructive actions, and in selectable mode an active highlight that slides from row to row with arrow-key navigation.

@reactframe.name: basic-table
@reactframe.title: Basic Table
@reactframe.description: A clean, semantic table for showing data as it is: plain, striped or bordered, comfortable or compact, a caption and a totals row, custom cells such as status pills, a sticky header that casts a shadow once you scroll, and rows that fade in on load.

@reactframe.name: blockquote
@reactframe.title: Blockquote
@reactframe.description: A quote with its author: a rule on the left, a large quotation mark, a framed card or a big centred pull quote, revealed as it scrolls into view with a highlighter sweeping across the phrase that matters.

@reactframe.name: masonry-grid
@reactframe.title: Masonry Grid
@reactframe.description: A masonry layout for tiles of different heights: each tile drops into the shortest column while keeping left-to-right order, the column count follows the container's width, and tiles spring to their new places when it changes.

@reactframe.name: bento-grid
@reactframe.title: Bento Grid
@reactframe.description: A bento layout of feature cells that span columns and rows, fall back to two and then one column as the container narrows, fade in one after another, and light up under the pointer, with a demo set of small live visuals.

@reactframe.name: sticky-header
@reactframe.title: Sticky Header
@reactframe.description: A site header that stays out of the way: it slides up while you scroll down and comes back the moment you scroll up, turns compact and frosted after the first few pixels, shows reading progress along its edge, and folds its links into a menu on narrow screens.

@reactframe.name: section-container
@reactframe.title: Section Container
@reactframe.description: A page-section wrapper that keeps widths, padding and headings consistent: an optional eyebrow, title and description, grid, dot or glow backgrounds that fade out at the edges, framed side rails with corner marks, and a gentle reveal as it scrolls in.

@reactframe.name: shape-divider
@reactframe.title: Shape Divider
@reactframe.description: SVG dividers that shape the edge between two sections: waves that drift in a seamless loop, a curve, a tilt, a peak, a zigzag or steps, layered in up to three tones, at the top or bottom of a section and mirrored if you like.

@reactframe.name: fieldset
@reactframe.title: Fieldset
@reactframe.description: A grouped form section on the native fieldset: the legend sits in a notch in the border, the group folds away to a one-line summary, a tick appears once it's complete, an error outlines it in coral, and disabling it disables every control inside.

@reactframe.name: theme-toggle
@reactframe.title: Theme Toggle
@reactframe.description: A light / dark switch that morphs a sun into a moon, or a Light · System · Dark control with a sliding pill; it remembers the choice, follows the OS in System mode, writes the theme to <html>, and can grow the new theme out of the button in a circle.

@reactframe.name: share-buttons
@reactframe.title: Share Buttons
@reactframe.description: Share buttons for X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Reddit, WhatsApp and email with a copy-link button that turns into a tick: round icons with hover labels, labelled pills, or a single Share button that fans out into the row, plus the device's own share sheet where it exists.

@reactframe.name: social-links
@reactframe.title: Social Links
@reactframe.description: Links to your profiles in three styles: round icons that fill from the bottom and tilt on hover, a list with handles, follower counts and an out arrow, or a dock whose icons grow as the pointer comes near.

@reactframe.name: scroll-progress-bar
@reactframe.title: Scroll Progress Bar
@reactframe.description: Reading progress in three forms: a thin spring-smoothed bar, a corner ring with the percentage that becomes a back-to-top button at the end, or a track split into your page's sections that labels the current one and jumps to any other.

@reactframe.name: payment-button
@reactframe.title: Payment Button
@reactframe.description: A pay button that shows every step of a payment: the amount, a spinner while it processes, a drawn tick when it's paid, a shake and a clear message when a card is declined, and an optional press-and-hold mode that fills up before it charges.

@reactframe.name: speed-dial
@reactframe.title: Speed Dial
@reactframe.description: A floating action button that opens into a short menu of actions: the plus turns into a close cross while actions spring out one after another in a line or a quarter-circle fan, each with a label, with an optional dimmed backdrop and full keyboard control.

@reactframe.name: animate-on-scroll
@reactframe.title: Animate on Scroll
@reactframe.description: A wrapper that brings content in as it scrolls into view: fade from any side, zoom, blur, flip or a clip-path wipe, one block at once or each child in turn, once or every time, watching the window or any scroll box.

@reactframe.name: focus-trap
@reactframe.title: Focus Trap
@reactframe.description: Keeps keyboard focus inside a dialog, drawer or menu while it's open: Tab and Shift+Tab loop through its controls, focus starts where you choose and returns to where it was, Escape calls you back, and an optional ring glides to whatever has focus.

@reactframe.name: icon-swap-toggle
@reactframe.title: Icon Swap Toggle
@reactframe.description: A toggle button that swaps between two icons with a rotate, 3D flip, pop or slide: ready-made pairs for play/pause, mute, like, save, show/hide, menu/close, light/dark and copy/copied, or any two icons of your own.

@reactframe.name: ripple-click-effect
@reactframe.title: Ripple Click Effect
@reactframe.description: A wrapper that makes any surface ripple where it's pressed: the wave grows while the pointer is held and fades when it lets go, several can overlap, icon buttons can ripple from the centre, and Enter or Space ripples for keyboard users.

@reactframe.name: toggle-price-counter
@reactframe.title: Toggle Price Counter
@reactframe.description: A monthly / yearly billing switch whose price rolls to the new amount digit by digit like an odometer, with a saving badge that pops when yearly is picked and a line that spells out what's billed and saved.

@reactframe.name: animated-underline-link
@reactframe.title: Animated Underline Link
@reactframe.description: Text links with underlines that move: a line that slides in from the left and out to the right, opens from the centre, draws as a wave, fills behind the text, sweeps like a highlighter, or pushes an arrow, with a faint resting line so they still read as links.

@reactframe.name: image-shape-mask
@reactframe.title: Image Shape Mask
@reactframe.description: Masks an image into a shape (circle, squircle, arch, hexagon, flower, blob or diamond) that grows out from the centre as it scrolls into view and morphs smoothly into another shape on hover while the photo slowly zooms.

@reactframe.name: typography-prose
@reactframe.title: Typography Prose
@reactframe.description: Readable styles for rich text from Markdown or a CMS, without a plugin: balanced headings with hover # links, comfortable line length and rhythm, lists, quotes, inline code, code blocks with a Copy button, tables, marks and keys, scoped so they never leak into the rest of the pag

@reactframe.name: variant-swatches
@reactframe.title: Variant Swatches
@reactframe.description: Product option pickers for colour and size: round colour swatches with a ring that glides to the pick, size chips with a sliding fill, the chosen value named in the label, sold-out options struck through, and a low-stock warning when only a few are left.

@reactframe.name: content-switch
@reactframe.title: Content Switch
@reactframe.description: A switch that swaps the content below it: a pill or underline thumb slides to the chosen option, the new panel slides in from that side (or fades or blurs in), and the box eases to the new height instead of jumping.

@reactframe.name: floating-label-input
@reactframe.title: Floating Label Input
@reactframe.description: A text field whose label sits inside it and floats up on focus or once filled, in outlined (label in a notch in the border), filled or underline styles, with an optional icon, clear button, validity tick, character count, helper text and a shake on error.

@reactframe.name: input-group
@reactframe.title: Input Group
@reactframe.description: Joins an input with text addons, icons, a select or a button into one field with one border and one focus ring: https:// and .com around a subdomain with a live availability tick, a price with a currency picker, a search with a shortcut, an invite with a send button.

@reactframe.name: masked-input
@reactframe.title: Masked Input
@reactframe.description: A formatted text field for phone numbers, dates, times, card numbers, ZIP codes or any pattern you define: separators fill themselves in, the rest of the template waits in faint ghost text, a thin bar tracks how much is filled, and a tick appears when it's complete.

@reactframe.name: knob
@reactframe.title: Knob
@reactframe.description: A rotary dial for picking a value in a range, like a mixer control: drag up or down, scroll or use the keyboard, with a 270° progress ring and a sliding thumb, or a physical-looking knob with an indicator and ticks that light up as it turns.

@reactframe.name: listbox
@reactframe.title: Listbox
@reactframe.description: An always-open list for picking one or several options: a search box that filters as you type, sticky group headings, avatars and descriptions, a highlight that follows the pointer or keyboard, checks that draw in, and type-ahead to jump by name.

@reactframe.name: toggle-button
@reactframe.title: Toggle Button
@reactframe.description: A button that stays pressed: the fill grows out from the middle, icons spin into their 'on' version, labels roll from Follow to Following and counts tick up by one. Outline, soft and ghost styles, icon-only or with text.

@reactframe.name: button-group
@reactframe.title: Button Group
@reactframe.description: Buttons joined into one control: plain action groups like Previous / Today / Next, a single-choice group whose fill slides between options, multi-toggle groups, and a split button whose chevron opens a menu of alternative actions.

@reactframe.name: dual-range-slider
@reactframe.title: Dual Range Slider
@reactframe.description: A two-handle range filter with a histogram behind it: bars inside the range light up, the result count rolls as you drag, the filled part drags both ends together, and Min / Max fields stay in sync for exact numbers.

@reactframe.name: repeatable-field-group
@reactframe.title: Repeatable Field Group
@reactframe.description: A set of fields people can repeat: add a row, remove one, drag rows into order. Rows grow in and slide out, focus lands in the new row, Enter in the last row adds another, and min / max limits keep the list in bounds.

@reactframe.name: filter-chips
@reactframe.title: Filter Chips
@reactframe.description: A row of pill filters with counts: a check draws in and the chip grows to fit it, neighbours slide over instead of jumping, and a Clear chip appears once anything is on. The demo filters a list of open roles that reflows as you pick.

@reactframe.name: icon-action-button
@reactframe.title: Icon Action Button
@reactframe.description: A compact icon-only button for toolbars and table rows: solid, soft, outline or ghost, square or round, four sizes, a tooltip that names the action, a count badge, a loading spinner and a danger tone for destructive actions.

@reactframe.name: glossy-gradient-button
@reactframe.title: Glossy Gradient Button
@reactframe.description: A premium call-to-action button with a glossy face: a lit gradient, a glass highlight on the top half, a band of light that sweeps across on hover, an arrow that nudges forward, and a press that sinks. Ink, paper and four colour palettes, or your own two stops.

@reactframe.name: inline-link-button
@reactframe.title: Inline Link Button
@reactframe.description: A text button that looks like a link, for secondary actions: Forgot password?, View all, Undo, Remove, Read the docs. Neutral, muted, accent or danger, an underline that's always on, on hover or off, an arrow that nudges, and a ↗ for external links. Renders a link when you pass h

@reactframe.name: emoji-rating-scale
@reactframe.title: Emoji Rating Scale
@reactframe.description: A five-face satisfaction rating for quick feedback: hand-drawn faces from a frown to a wide smile that wobble on hover, fill with their own colour and pop when picked, a label that rolls in underneath, and full keyboard support as a radio group.

@reactframe.name: side-tab-menu
@reactframe.title: Side Tab Menu
@reactframe.description: A vertical tab menu for settings pages: tabs with icons, second-line descriptions and count badges, grouped under headings, an active highlight with a rail that slides between them, and a panel that fades to the chosen tab. Stacks on phones.

@reactframe.name: dot-pager-indicator
@reactframe.title: Dot Pager Indicator
@reactframe.description: Dots that show where you are in a carousel or onboarding flow: the active dot stretches into a pill, a progress style fills the pill and moves on by itself like stories, and a window style shows five dots out of many and shrinks the edge ones. Clickable and keyboard friendly.

@reactframe.name: vertical-progress-steps
@reactframe.title: Vertical Progress Steps
@reactframe.description: A live status tracker for multi-step processes like deploys, imports and order tracking: each step is done, running, waiting or failed, the connector fills as steps finish, the running step spins and shows its log lines, and screen readers hear every change.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/hero-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Two-column hero section with an announcement badge, headline, subtitle, and primary/secondary CTA buttons. Place it as the first section of your landing page to immediately communicate your product value and drive sign-ups.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/hero-02
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Centered hero section with a grid background, headline, CTA buttons, and a featured product screenshot. Use it above the fold on app or SaaS landing pages to visually showcase your product and guide visitors toward action.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/hero-03
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Two-column hero with star rating social proof, key statistics card, and call-to-action buttons. Use it when you need to build immediate trust and highlight traction metrics on SaaS or agency landing pages.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/hero-05
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Minimal full-screen centered hero with headline, subtitle, and CTA buttons on a clean background. Use it as a distraction-free entry point for products that rely on strong copy rather than visuals.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/feature-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Three-column feature grid displaying product benefits as icon cards with titles and descriptions. Use it to quickly communicate your product's key capabilities anywhere on a SaaS or marketing landing page.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/feature-03
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Two-column image grid showcasing product features with visual screenshots and short descriptions. Use it to let your interface speak for itself while giving context for each feature shown.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/feature-04
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Three-column icon card grid for listing product features with icons, titles, and short descriptions. Use it as a lightweight, fast-loading feature showcase section that stays scannable on any screen size.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/feature-05
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Interactive accordion feature section where clicking each item reveals a corresponding product screenshot. Use it to keep the section compact while letting users explore features at their own pace.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/pricing-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Three-column pricing table with a monthly/yearly billing toggle, a highlighted recommended plan, and feature lists. Use it on dedicated pricing pages to help users choose the right plan and increase conversion.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/pricing-02
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Side-by-side pricing comparison table with feature rows and checkmark/cross indicators. Use it when your plans share many features and you want to make the differences crystal clear for potential buyers.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/pricing-03
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Three-column pricing section with a tabbed billing toggle, feature lists with separators, and CTA buttons. Use it as an alternative pricing layout when you want to visually emphasize the most popular plan.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/pricing-04
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Three-column pricing section with a highlighted popular plan featuring a dark gradient background, monthly/yearly billing toggle with a green indicator, and custom price display. Use it for SaaS products that want to visually differentiate the recommended plan.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/pricing-stripe-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Connected pricing section that fetches products and prices live from the Stripe API and renders them as cards. Each card shows the plan name, description, amount, and a checkout button that creates a Stripe Checkout session.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/cta-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Horizontal call-to-action section with a heading, description, and primary/secondary CTA buttons. Use it at the end of landing page sections to nudge visitors toward sign-up or purchase at the right moment.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/cta-02
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] CTA card with an app or device mockup image, headline, and action button. Use it to close a landing page with a visually driven conversion prompt that showcases your product in context.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/cta-03
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Newsletter subscription CTA with an email input and a submit button. Use it to capture leads directly within your content by embedding a low-friction email signup anywhere on the page.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/cta-04
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Centered CTA card with a subtle grid background, bold headline, description, and action button. Use it as a section-closing block that re-engages visitors who scrolled past earlier conversion points.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/faq-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Single-column accordion FAQ section with expandable question and answer items. Use it on landing pages, pricing pages, or support sections to address common objections and reduce incoming support requests.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/faq-02
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Two-column accordion FAQ grid for displaying a larger set of questions side by side. Use it when you have ten or more questions and want to keep the FAQ section compact and well-organized.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/testimonial-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Scrolling testimonial section with two animated marquee rows of customer review cards. Use it as a social proof belt on landing pages to continuously surface customer validation without requiring any user interaction.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/testimonial-02
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Masonry grid wall-of-love section displaying multiple customer reviews in a varied layout. Use it on marketing sites where you have rich social proof and want to display it in a visually engaging way.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/stat-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Stats section displaying key product or business metrics in individual icon cards with labels. Use it to quantify your impact on landing pages and give visitors concrete, trust-building numbers.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/stat-02
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Horizontal stats section with large numbers and labels separated by dividers. Use it as a compact, eye-catching metrics strip that fits naturally between any two sections on a landing page.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/logo-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Logo cloud section with two infinite scrolling marquee rows showcasing partner or customer logos. Use it immediately after your hero section to build trust through brand association with recognized names.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/contact-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Contact section with a card-wrapped form (name, email, message) alongside company contact information. Use it on contact or about pages to give visitors a direct, professional way to reach your team.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/footer-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Multi-column footer with company branding, grouped navigation links, and social media icons. Use it on every page of your site to provide consistent navigation, important links, and legal information at the bottom.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/navbar-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Responsive navbar with dropdown navigation menus on desktop and an accordion-based mobile menu. Use it as your site-wide header to provide clear, accessible navigation across all screen sizes and devices.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/team-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Team section displaying members in cards with profile photos, names, job roles, and social links. Use it on about pages to humanize your brand and help visitors connect with the people behind your product.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/social-icons
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Collection of SVG social media brand icons (GitHub, Google, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, and more) as composable React components. Use them in login forms, footers, navbars, or any UI that references external social platforms.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/login-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Split-screen login page with a gradient background on one side and an email/password form with OAuth buttons on the other. Use it as a drop-in authentication page when you need a polished login experience fast.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/blog-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Blog section with post cards featuring cover images, category badges, titles, excerpts, and author info. Use it on content sites or product blogs to display articles in a clean, scannable grid layout.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/register-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Centered registration card with full name, email, and password fields, including client-side validation. Use it as a clean sign-up page for any web application that requires user account creation.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/background-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Customizable square grid background component with adjustable line color, grid size, and opacity props. Use it as a decorative backdrop for hero sections, cards, or any area that benefits from a subtle geometric texture.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/background-02
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Customizable dot pattern background with adjustable dot color, size, spacing, and opacity. Use it behind hero sections or feature areas to add visual depth without distracting from your main content.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/background-03
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Customizable diagonal stripes background with adjustable line color, width, spacing, and opacity. Use it to add a subtle textile-like pattern to sections, cards, or full-page backgrounds.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/background-04
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Customizable vertical lines background with adjustable line count, width, color, and opacity. Use it behind hero or pricing sections to create a structured, architectural visual backdrop.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/background-05
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Interactive grid background where individual cells highlight on hover with a configurable glow color. Use it behind hero sections or interactive showcases to add a playful, dynamic feel to an otherwise static layout.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/changelog-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Timeline-style changelog listing product updates with version numbers, release dates, and descriptions. Use it on product or documentation sites to communicate release history and build trust with power users.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/integration-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Dark-themed integration showcase with a curved connection path drawn between tool logos. Use it on landing pages to visually communicate how your product fits into your users' existing toolchain.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/banner-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Full-width announcement banner with a short message, an arrow link, and a dismiss button. Use it at the top of any page to surface time-sensitive promotions, feature launches, or important product updates.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/waitlist-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Waitlist signup section with an email capture form and social proof avatars showing subscriber count. Use it on coming-soon pages to build an audience before your product launches and validate demand early.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/waitlist-02
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Waitlist section with a Supabase-connected email form that stores submissions directly to your database. Use it when your backend is Supabase and you want a zero-config waitlist with persistent storage out of the box.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/feature-06
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Four-step process section with numbered badges, step titles, descriptions, and an optional screenshot. Use it to explain how your product works, step by step, on landing and onboarding pages.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/feature-07
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Full-width video player section with a poster image and an animated play button overlay. Use it on landing pages to embed a product demo or explainer video where showing beats telling.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/comparison-01
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Product comparison table with images, specification rows, and checkmark/cross value indicators. Use it on product or pricing pages to help users make confident purchase decisions by clearly highlighting key differences.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/dashboard-02
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Sales analytics dashboard with revenue KPI cards, interactive bar charts, and a recent orders table. Use it as a starting point for admin panels, analytics views, or any SaaS backend interface.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/logo-02
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Client logo grid with clickable industry and technology category filters and featured logo cards. Use it on portfolio or case study pages to showcase logos while allowing visitors to filter by what matters to them.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/login-02
@registrydirectory.description: [Shadcnship] Full-stack split-screen auth page with Supabase email/password login and OAuth provider support. Use it as a complete, ready-to-ship login page when your backend is powered by Supabase Auth.

@registrydirectory.name: arnaudvolp/data-table-01

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/ai-prompt
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated AI chat input with model selection dropdown, file attachment and auto-resizing textarea. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/command-button
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Keyboard shortcut button with a Command icon, hover shimmer sweep, and smooth CSS transitions, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/card-flip
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Interactive card that flips in 3D on hover to reveal features and a call to action, built with React and Tailwind CSS transforms and transitions.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/smooth-drawer
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Bottom drawer with spring-based slide-in and staggered content reveal, built on Vaul with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/shape-hero
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Hero section with translucent geometric shapes that drop in and float over a gradient backdrop. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/ai-text-loading
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated AI thinking indicator that cycles status messages with a shimmering gradient text effect. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/shimmer-text
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated shimmer text with a looping gradient sweep across the letters, built with React, Tailwind CSS gradients and Motion animations.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/carousel-cards
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Horizontally scrolling card carousel with ratings, badges and arrow navigation, built with React, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui primitives.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/file-upload
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Drag and drop file upload with animated progress, file validation and error states. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/action-search-bar
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Search bar with debounced input, shortcut hints, and an animated action suggestions dropdown, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/ai-input-search
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] AI search chat input with toggleable web search mode, file attachment and auto-resizing textarea. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/currency-transfer
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Multi-step currency exchange card with animated progress and SVG checkmark confirmation, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/background-paths
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated background of flowing SVG line paths drawn across the hero section. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion path animations.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/mouse-effect-card
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Interactive card with an animated dot pattern that repels away from the cursor, powered by React, Tailwind CSS and Motion spring physics.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/beams-background
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated background of drifting light beams rendered on an HTML canvas with configurable intensity. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/flow-field
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Canvas particle flow field background with noise-driven streams of glowing light, color themes and density options. Built with React and Motion.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/apple-activity-card
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated activity rings card inspired by the Apple Fitness app, with progress circles built in React using Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/ai-voice
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] AI voice input button with recording timer, pulsing waveform bars and listening state. Built with React and animated Tailwind CSS styles.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/smooth-tab
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated tab switcher with a sliding active indicator and smooth card content transitions, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/team-selector
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated team size selector with stacked overlapping avatars, spring transitions and increment controls. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/switch-button
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Light and dark theme toggle button with a rotating sun icon and shimmer hover effect, built with React, next-themes, and Tailwind CSS.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/bento-grid
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Responsive bento grid of feature cards with animated charts, counters and timelines, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/social-button
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Share button that expands into a row of social icon buttons with staggered Motion animations on hover, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/hold-button
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Press-and-hold confirmation button with an animated progress fill, configurable hold duration, and color variants, built with React and Motion.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/attract-button
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Magnetic button that pulls floating particles to its center on hover using Motion spring animations, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/gradient-button
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Layered gradient button with emerald, purple, and orange variants, soft inner glow, and hover overlay, styled entirely with Tailwind CSS in React.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/v0-button
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Open in v0 button that sends a component registry JSON to v0.dev for instant editing, built with React, the shadcn Button, and Tailwind CSS.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/toolbar
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Figma-inspired toolbar where the selected tool expands to reveal its label with spring animations, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/ai-loading
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated AI loading state cycling task statuses through a scrolling code-style log with an SVG progress spinner. Built with React and Tailwind CSS.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/card-stack
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Stack of product cards that expands on click to reveal details and specs, animated with Motion and styled with React and Tailwind CSS.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/avatar-picker
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated avatar picker with SVG avatar options, colored selection ring and username input. Built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/type-writer
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Typewriter text animation that types and deletes multiple sequences with a blinking cursor and auto loop, built with React and Motion.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/swoosh-text
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Hover text effect with layered colorful shadows that snap flat on mouseover, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion hover animations.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/sliced-text
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Text effect that splits into two offset slices and merges together on hover using clip-path, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/glitch-text
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Customizable glitch text effect with adjustable intensity, colors and sizes, animated in React with Motion and styled with Tailwind CSS.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/matrix-text
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Matrix-style text effect where letters scramble through binary characters before revealing, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/dynamic-text
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Animated text switcher that cycles through greetings in multiple languages, built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion enter and exit transitions.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/particle-button
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Button that bursts animated particles from its center on click with a quick scale press effect, built with React, Motion, and Tailwind CSS.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/tweet-card
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] X (Twitter) style post card with author details, verified badge, reply thread and hover gradient, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/scroll-text
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Scroll-driven text list that highlights the active word as you scroll, using IntersectionObserver with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion animations.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/liquid-glass-card
@registrydirectory.description: [kokonut/ui] Apple-inspired liquid glass card and buttons using SVG displacement filters for a refractive effect, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

@registrydirectory.name: kokonutui/profile-dropdown

@scrimui.name: all
@scrimui.title: All free components
@scrimui.description: Every free Scrim UI component — 55 in total, from prompt inputs and streaming messages to tool calls and citations.

@scrimui.name: prompt-input
@scrimui.title: Prompt Input
@scrimui.description: The message input at the heart of an AI chat app — file attachments, model picker, tool toggles, voice, and a send button that turns into stop.

@scrimui.name: prompt-input-attachments
@scrimui.title: Prompt Input + Attachments
@scrimui.description: A chat input that accepts file uploads — attachment chips with upload progress, type icons, and one-click removal.

@scrimui.name: prompt-input-model-selector
@scrimui.title: Prompt Input + Model Selector
@scrimui.description: A chat input with the model picker built in — switch models inline, with badges for what each one can do.

@scrimui.name: prompt-editor
@scrimui.title: Prompt Editor
@scrimui.description: A prompt template editor with {{variables}} highlighted as you type, a rendered preview, and a line diff against the previous version.

@scrimui.name: streaming-message
@scrimui.title: Streaming Message
@scrimui.description: Render an AI reply token by token like ChatGPT's typing effect — blinking cursor, stop button, and no layout jump as the text grows.

@scrimui.name: user-message
@scrimui.title: User Message
@scrimui.description: The user's chat bubble — right-aligned, with hover actions to copy, edit the prompt, or regenerate the answer.

@scrimui.name: message-actions
@scrimui.title: Message Actions
@scrimui.description: The action row under an AI reply — copy, regenerate, share and thumbs up/down feedback, revealed on hover.

@scrimui.name: error-message
@scrimui.title: Error & Retry
@scrimui.description: What to show when a generation fails — a plain-English reason, a retry button, and a countdown for rate limits.

@scrimui.name: markdown-message
@scrimui.title: Markdown Message
@scrimui.description: A rendered markdown reply — syntax-highlighted code blocks with copy buttons, plus tables, lists and safe links.

@scrimui.name: streaming-markdown
@scrimui.title: Streaming Markdown
@scrimui.description: Markdown that renders correctly while it is still arriving — bold, code spans, links and tables settle without ever flashing raw syntax or reflowing.

@scrimui.name: response-versions
@scrimui.title: Response Versions
@scrimui.description: The 1/3 pager after a regenerate — previous and next versions, branch markers, continue-from-here, and honest generating, failed and stopped states.

@scrimui.name: conversation-sidebar
@scrimui.title: Conversation Sidebar
@scrimui.description: The chat-history sidebar every AI app rebuilds — search, inline rename, pin, and delete with undo, grouped by date, with loading and empty states.

@scrimui.name: artifact-preview
@scrimui.title: Artifact Preview
@scrimui.description: The side panel for generated output — preview/code toggle, copy, download, version switching, and streaming, error and stale states.

@scrimui.name: reasoning
@scrimui.title: Thinking / Reasoning
@scrimui.description: A collapsible chain-of-thought panel — show the model's reasoning trace with elapsed time, folded away by default.

@scrimui.name: thinking-indicator
@scrimui.title: Thinking Indicator
@scrimui.description: The loading state before the first token — bouncing dots, a blinking caret, or a labeled status line while the model thinks.

@scrimui.name: reasoning-steps
@scrimui.title: Reasoning Steps
@scrimui.description: A multi-step reasoning trace — each step with its own status and timer, so a long think reads as progress, not a hang.

@scrimui.name: tool-call
@scrimui.title: Tool Call
@scrimui.description: How to show a function call in chat — the arguments sent, the result returned, run status, and an expand toggle.

@scrimui.name: search-tool-call
@scrimui.title: Search Tool Call
@scrimui.description: A web search the model ran — the query it chose, how many results came back, and previews of the sources it read.

@scrimui.name: code-execution
@scrimui.title: Code Execution
@scrimui.description: A code interpreter run inside chat — the snippet, a running state, stdout as it streams, and errors that stay readable.

@scrimui.name: generative-ui
@scrimui.title: Generative UI
@scrimui.description: Render a React component from a tool result instead of text — a skeleton in the widget's own shape, and a text fallback when the client has no renderer.

@scrimui.name: generated-media
@scrimui.title: Generated Media Result
@scrimui.description: The result card for AI-generated images, audio and video — queue and stage states, variants, download and regenerate, and a safety block that isn't an error.

@scrimui.name: source-card
@scrimui.title: Source Card
@scrimui.description: A cited source as a card — favicon, page title, domain, and the snippet the answer actually drew from.

@scrimui.name: source-list
@scrimui.title: Source List
@scrimui.description: The passages retrieval actually returned, with similarity scores and a visible relevance floor — including the case where nothing cleared it.

@scrimui.name: citation-ui
@scrimui.title: Citation UI
@scrimui.description: Inline citation markers in generated text — numbered footnotes that reveal the source in a hover preview card.

@scrimui.name: citation-popover
@scrimui.title: Citation Popover
@scrimui.description: A citation marker that shows the passage it came from — fixed positioning that survives a scrolling answer, touch and keyboard, and an honest state for a number the model invented.

@scrimui.name: agent-status
@scrimui.title: Agent Status
@scrimui.description: Status for an AI agent working on its own — running, waiting on you, completed or failed, with what it did last.

@scrimui.name: approval-request
@scrimui.title: Approval Request
@scrimui.description: The human-in-the-loop confirmation — what the agent wants to do, the exact details, and allow or deny before it acts.

@scrimui.name: approval-gate
@scrimui.title: Approval Gate
@scrimui.description: The approval card as a lifecycle: a decision that survives a closed tab, is idempotent across two open ones, and says what happened when it lands after the request expired.

@scrimui.name: agent-plan
@scrimui.title: Agent Plan
@scrimui.description: The checklist an agent writes for itself and then edits mid-run — steps added, skipped and re-ordered, without the list jumping under the reader.

@scrimui.name: agent-handoff
@scrimui.title: Agent Handoff
@scrimui.description: One agent passing work to another — who asked, what was carried across, and what the receiving agent was not told.

@scrimui.name: agent-run-timeline
@scrimui.title: Agent Run Timeline
@scrimui.description: The activity log for a long agent run — collapsible success clusters, retry-linked events, approval gates in place, and a follow that respects the reader.

@scrimui.name: response-rating
@scrimui.title: Response Rating
@scrimui.description: Thumbs up and down that ask the one follow-up question worth asking — with a state for feedback that has been sent and cannot be taken back.

@scrimui.name: inline-correction
@scrimui.title: Inline Correction
@scrimui.description: Fix the answer where it is wrong, in place — the edit becomes training data, so the component keeps the original alongside it rather than overwriting it.

@scrimui.name: output-comparison
@scrimui.title: Output Comparison
@scrimui.description: Two answers, side by side, with the model names hidden until a winner is picked — because a visible label is the thing being measured.

@scrimui.name: eval-results
@scrimui.title: Eval Results
@scrimui.description: Pass rates per test case across two runs, with the regressions surfaced first and a sample size honest enough to say when a delta means nothing.

@scrimui.name: edit-diff-view
@scrimui.title: Edit Diff View
@scrimui.description: A streamed AI edit as hunks you accept or reject one by one — id-keyed decisions, word-level marks, and buttons that stay disabled while a hunk is still arriving.

@scrimui.name: file-upload
@scrimui.title: File Upload
@scrimui.description: A drag-and-drop upload zone — per-file progress bars, type icons, and error states for files too big or of the wrong type.

@scrimui.name: context-files
@scrimui.title: Context Files
@scrimui.description: The files currently in the model's context — sizes, how many tokens each one costs, and removal without leaving the chat.

@scrimui.name: context-picker
@scrimui.title: Context Picker
@scrimui.description: The @-mention menu for adding context to a prompt — files, web pages and knowledge bases with search, recent items, access states and token cost.

@scrimui.name: context-usage
@scrimui.title: Context Usage
@scrimui.description: How much of the context window is gone and to what — system prompt, files, history — plus what gets dropped first when the next message does not fit.

@scrimui.name: memory-list
@scrimui.title: Memory List
@scrimui.description: The memory panel — every fact the assistant has saved about the user, with the ability to add one or make it forget.

@scrimui.name: memory-suggestion
@scrimui.title: Memory Suggestion
@scrimui.description: The prompt an assistant shows before saving something about you — the fact it noticed, and your choice to keep or dismiss it.

@scrimui.name: memory-chip
@scrimui.title: Memory Chip
@scrimui.description: A small inline chip confirming a fact was saved to memory — quiet enough to ignore, clear enough to undo.

@scrimui.name: model-selector
@scrimui.title: Model Selector
@scrimui.description: A standalone model picker — compare models in a dropdown with badges for speed, context length and what each supports.

@scrimui.name: reasoning-level
@scrimui.title: Reasoning Level
@scrimui.description: A control for how hard the model should think — light, balanced or deep, with the tradeoff between speed and depth shown.

@scrimui.name: tool-toggle
@scrimui.title: Tool Toggle
@scrimui.description: Switches for the tools a model may use — web search, code execution, file access — with unmistakable on and off states.

@scrimui.name: cost-meter
@scrimui.title: Cost Meter
@scrimui.description: Live spend per message and per conversation — cached input priced apart from fresh, reasoning tokens shown without double-counting, and a visible ~ when a provider did not report enough to be sure.

@scrimui.name: voice-input
@scrimui.title: Voice Input
@scrimui.description: A microphone button that expands into a recording panel — live waveform, a running transcript, and cancel or send.

@scrimui.name: voice-waveform
@scrimui.title: Voice Waveform
@scrimui.description: An animated audio waveform — distinct bar motion for listening, recording, and the assistant speaking back.

@scrimui.name: voice-conversation
@scrimui.title: Voice Conversation
@scrimui.description: A voice conversation as it happens — who is speaking, the live transcript, and replay for any individual turn.

@scrimui.name: refusal-message
@scrimui.title: Refusal Message
@scrimui.description: How to say no without ending the conversation — the refusal, a plain-language reason, and one redirect the reader can click.

@scrimui.name: moderation-flag
@scrimui.title: Moderation Flag
@scrimui.description: What to show when the content filter fires — a stopped stream that keeps its partial text, or a blocked prompt, with a false-positive path.

@scrimui.name: confidence-answer
@scrimui.title: Confidence Answer
@scrimui.description: An answer that says how sure it is — a warning badge only when there is something to warn about, and a hedge that names what to verify.

@scrimui.name: voice-call-controls

@scrimui.description: The chrome around a live voice call — an unmistakable mute toggle, a running call timer, and an end button that's always one tap away.

@scrimui.name: memory-toast

@scrimui.name: ai-chat

@scrimui.name: research-assistant

@scrimui.name: coding-agent

@scrimui.name: voice-assistant
@scrimui.title: AI Voice Assistant

@scrimui.name: model-preferences

@scrimui.name: artifact-workspace

@scrimui.name: rag-workspace

@ssych.description: Any SVG mark as a holographic badge: a silver dome under a thin film whose colour shifts with the angle, with a fine sparkle. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click.

@ssych.name: glass-badge
@ssych.title: Glass Badge
@ssych.description: Any SVG mark as a frosted glass badge: translucent, with the light catching its rolled edge and the page showing through. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click.

@ssych.name: neon-badge
@ssych.title: Neon Badge
@ssych.description: Any SVG mark as a dark badge with a neon outline that glows and breathes. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click.

@ssych.name: lightning-badge
@ssych.title: Lightning Badge
@ssych.description: Any SVG mark as a dark glass badge with lightning crawling over its face. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click.

@ssych.name: ascii-badge
@ssych.title: ASCII Badge
@ssych.description: Any SVG mark as a domed badge drawn in characters: the lit surface is read per cell and each cell's brightness picks a character from the ramp, so the letters change with the light as it turns. Drawn in WebGPU, it leans toward the cursor and flips on click.

@ssych.name: portfolio-book
@ssych.title: Portfolio Overview (paid screen)

@ssych.name: portfolio-allocation
@ssych.title: Portfolio Allocation (paid screen)

@ssych.name: portfolio-tiers
@ssych.title: Multi-account Portfolio (paid screen)
@ssych.description: The book as four accounts rather than one balance. One pill per tier under the bar, and the pill row is a selector rather than decoration, carrying share-of-total on the tier.

@ssych.name: discover-board
@ssych.title: Market Discovery (paid screen)
@ssych.description: The browsing problem, not the reporting one: filters and a trending rail for finding something you do not already hold.

@ssych.name: discover-screener
@ssych.title: Token Screener (paid screen)
@ssych.description: The screener take on discovery: a dense sortable board where the row is the unit and the filters carry the state.

@ssych.name: terminal-cex
@ssych.title: Trading Terminal (paid screen)
@ssych.description: An exchange terminal on one ruled workspace: candle chart under an interval bar, book or tape as tabs, ticket and account on the right, and a full-width positions register at the fold.

@ssych.name: gpu-pods
@ssych.title: GPU Marketplace (paid screen)

@ssych.name: ascii-scroll-morph
@ssych.title: ASCII Scroll Morph (paid screen)
@ssych.description: An immersive landing page with live 3D ASCII shapes that respond to the cursor and transition as you scroll. Adapt the vector artwork, copy and colours in code to fit your brand, while keeping the motion system intact.

@ssych.name: tradeboard-landing
@ssych.title: Trading Platform Landing (paid screen)
@ssych.description: A product landing built on one rule: one ground, one subject, one accent. Giant display headline, the product UI as the hero image, then metric cards, a bento container grid and a three-step band.

@ssych.name: stablecoin-landing
@ssych.title: Stablecoin Landing (paid screen)
@ssych.description: A token landing on the same structure: hero with a brand marquee, a three-card product explainer, a backers marquee and a use-modes grid. Everything structural is shared with the Tradeboard page, so the two stay one system.

@ssych.name: simple-landing
@ssych.title: Developer Tools Landing (paid screen)
@ssych.description: The library's own marketing page: a near-black ground, one object per section, two-tone display type carrying the hierarchy, and every count read live from the registry.

@starseam.name: theme
@starseam.title: starseam theme
@starseam.description: The token layer — lacquer ground, structural rivets, severity colour, the em grid, and per-language CJK font stacks. Every other item pulls this.

@starseam.name: plate
@starseam.title: Plate
@starseam.description: The base surface. One iron plate — no shadow, no glass.

@starseam.name: seam
@starseam.title: Seam
@starseam.description: The signature: a row of rivets marking where two blocks actually join.

@starseam.name: lames
@starseam.title: Lames
@starseam.description: A stack of plates, each pressing onto the one below.

@starseam.name: label
@starseam.title: Label
@starseam.description: An instrument label — mono, small, widely tracked.

@starseam.name: value
@starseam.title: Value
@starseam.description: A readout with tabular figures and a severity state.

@starseam.name: status-dot
@starseam.title: Status dot
@starseam.description: A single rivet standing in for a status. Only critical animates.

@starseam.name: mark
@starseam.title: Mark
@starseam.description: Helmet plan, star chart, radar scope — one mark, three true readings.

@starseam.name: stat-band
@starseam.title: Stat band
@starseam.description: The instrument strip: cells divided by seam lines.

@starseam.name: code-tag
@starseam.title: Code tag
@starseam.description: A mono identifier — a stack item, a version, a CVE.

@starseam.name: code-block
@starseam.title: Code block
@starseam.description: A plate that holds source code: filename label, copy, a folding seam. Ink shades only — colour is severity, never syntax.

@starseam.name: copy-button
@starseam.title: Copy button
@starseam.description: A quiet text button that puts a value on the clipboard. The confirmation is a rivet, never lapis.

@starseam.name: plate-button
@starseam.title: Plate button
@starseam.description: A cut plate you can press. Square corners, hairline edge, no fill.

@starseam.name: button-group
@starseam.title: Button group
@starseam.description: Buttons riveted into one strip: one hairline frame, seams between the members.

@starseam.name: mode-switch
@starseam.title: Mode switch
@starseam.description: auto / console (夜勤) / report (日勤). Two materials, not an inversion; the selection is a rivet, never lapis.

@starseam.name: plate-input
@starseam.title: Plate input
@starseam.description: A cut plate you can write into. Focus drives the one blue rivet on the screen.

@starseam.name: plate-textarea
@starseam.title: Plate textarea
@starseam.description: The long-form plate, set on the body leading rather than the UI one.

@starseam.name: field
@starseam.title: Field
@starseam.description: Wires label, control, hint and error together. The error is the only place a field takes colour.

@starseam.name: plate-checkbox
@starseam.title: Plate checkbox
@starseam.description: A checked box is a rivet driven home — steel, not blue.

@starseam.name: plate-switch
@starseam.title: Plate switch
@starseam.description: The thumb is a rivet sliding along its seam.

@starseam.name: plate-select
@starseam.title: Plate select
@starseam.description: A list floating on the lightest cut of lacquer. Selection is marked by a rivet.

@starseam.name: plate-dialog
@starseam.title: Plate dialog
@starseam.description: A plate lifted clear of the page. Riveted seams at the header and footer joins.

@starseam.name: plate-sheet
@starseam.title: Plate sheet
@starseam.description: A panel drawn out from an edge — the one directional exception to stillness.

@starseam.name: plate-dropdown-menu
@starseam.title: Plate dropdown
@starseam.description: Menu on strong lacquer. Dividers are scored hairlines, not riveted seams.

@starseam.name: plate-tabs
@starseam.title: Plate tabs
@starseam.description: Tab strip and panel are two plates that meet, so a riveted seam runs between them.

@starseam.name: plate-table
@starseam.title: Plate table
@starseam.description: Rows as lames. Rivets only at the head/body join.

@starseam.name: alert
@starseam.title: Alert
@starseam.description: A message plate with a severity edge. The colour never stands alone — the title carries the meaning.

@starseam.name: badge
@starseam.title: Badge
@starseam.description: A stamped status tag: hairline border, no fill. Colour is severity, never decoration.

@starseam.name: kbd
@starseam.title: Kbd
@starseam.description: A key cap: a raised plate the size of a keystroke, pressed metal without a shadow.

@starseam.name: skeleton
@starseam.title: Skeleton
@starseam.description: A placeholder plate. It does not shimmer — the only permitted loop belongs to crit.

@starseam.name: avatar
@starseam.title: Avatar
@starseam.description: An identity plate: square, hairline seam, instrument-lettered fallback.

@starseam.name: progress
@starseam.title: Progress
@starseam.description: A determinate reading in rivet steel. No indeterminate sweep — an endless loop belongs to crit alone.

@starseam.name: breadcrumb
@starseam.title: Breadcrumb
@starseam.description: A path through the structure. Every junction is a real boundary, so the separators are rivets.

@starseam.name: pagination
@starseam.title: Pagination
@starseam.description: Page links; the current page is a rivet and full-strength text, never lapis.

@starseam.name: plate-radio-group
@starseam.title: Plate radio group
@starseam.description: The chosen option holds a rivet driven into its centre. Selection is silver, never lapis.

@starseam.name: plate-slider
@starseam.title: Plate slider
@starseam.description: A setting dragged along a seam. Track, range, and thumb are steel; blue appears only as focus.

@starseam.name: plate-toggle
@starseam.title: Plate toggle
@starseam.description: A pressed-state button. On is a rivet and a deeper fill, never lapis.

@starseam.name: plate-accordion
@starseam.title: Plate accordion
@starseam.description: Stacked plates that open along their seams; the open item holds a rivet.

@starseam.name: plate-collapsible
@starseam.title: Plate collapsible
@starseam.description: A single section that opens along its seam — the accordion's one-item cousin.

@starseam.name: scroll-area
@starseam.title: Scroll area
@starseam.description: A viewport with an instrument scrollbar: hairline channel, steel thumb, no floating pill.

@starseam.name: plate-tooltip
@starseam.title: Plate tooltip
@starseam.description: An instrument annotation: the lightest plate, hairline edge, no shadow and no arrow.

@starseam.name: plate-popover
@starseam.title: Plate popover
@starseam.description: A small plate lifted beside its trigger. Entry and exit come from the theme.

@starseam.name: plate-hover-card
@starseam.title: Plate hover card
@starseam.description: A dossier plate raised on hover — the popover's read-only sibling.

@starseam.name: plate-alert-dialog
@starseam.title: Plate alert dialog
@starseam.description: The dialog's stricter sibling: an answer is required. Same plate, same seams.

@starseam.name: plate-context-menu
@starseam.title: Plate context menu
@starseam.description: The dropdown menu summoned at the pointer. Destructive actions take 緋, always with text.

@starseam.name: plate-menubar
@starseam.title: Plate menubar
@starseam.description: A console menu strip: instrument-lettered triggers, menus falling as dropdown plates.

@starseam.name: plate-command
@starseam.title: Plate command
@starseam.description: The console palette: type, filter, execute. The highlighted row is a rivet, never lapis.

@starseam.name: plate-calendar
@starseam.title: Plate calendar
@starseam.description: A month on the full-width grid; the selected day is a rivet driven home.

@starseam.name: plate-date-picker
@starseam.title: Plate date picker
@starseam.description: A calendar in a popover. The date lands in a hidden input — no callback required.

@starseam.name: plate-combobox
@starseam.title: Plate combobox
@starseam.description: A select with a filter line. Options are data, the value rides a hidden input.

@starseam.name: plate-toast
@starseam.title: Plate toast
@starseam.description: Message plates sliding in from the edge. Severity is a coloured seam plus the text itself.

@starseam.name: plate-input-otp
@starseam.title: Plate input OTP
@starseam.description: A code entered one plate at a time. The active slot is edged in lapis because it holds focus.

@starseam.name: ledger
@starseam.title: Ledger
@starseam.description: An instrument list: labelled entries on one plate, each row cut from the next by a seam. The archetype is a logbook page.

@starseam.name: rail
@starseam.title: Rail
@starseam.description: A constellation of anchors: one vertical seam, one star per entry, the current one lit via aria-current. Structure only — docking and chrome belong to the consumer.

@starseam.name: glyph
@starseam.title: Glyph
@starseam.description: The glyph set: hairline instrument marks on the 24-unit grid — cut, not moulded. Monochrome, currentColor, never a severity.

@svelte-bits.name: rubber-segment

@svelte-bits.name: scrub-field

@svelte-bits.name: slide-commit

@svelte-bits.name: sling-button

@svelte-bits.name: slosh-gauge

@svelte-bits.name: spring-check

@svelte-bits.name: squish-switch

@svelte-bits.name: status-mark

@svelte-bits.name: swipe-row
