@svelte-bits.name: swipe-toast

@svelte-bits.name: tear-ticket

The artwork tilts in 3D with parallax on hover.

@turbopills-ui.name: before-after-card
@turbopills-ui.title: Before / After Card
@turbopills-ui.description: A before/after image card with a footer badge.

@turbopills-ui.name: bmi-card
@turbopills-ui.title: BMI Card
@turbopills-ui.description: A configurable BMI indicator ring with thresholds and tooltip.

@turbopills-ui.name: input
@turbopills-ui.title: Input
@turbopills-ui.description: Input field with title, hint, suffix and error message.

@turbopills-ui.name: masked-input
@turbopills-ui.title: Masked Input
@turbopills-ui.description: Masked input with presets (tel/date) and optional calendar picker.

@turbopills-ui.name: multiple-choice
@turbopills-ui.title: Multiple Choice
@turbopills-ui.description: Multiple choice field with optional max selections.

@turbopills-ui.name: single-choice
@turbopills-ui.title: Single Choice
@turbopills-ui.description: Single choice field (list or cells) with optional deselect.

@turbopills-ui.name: progress-cells
@turbopills-ui.title: Progress (Cells)
@turbopills-ui.description: Segmented progress bar with optional labels/tooltips.

@tween-ui.name: icon-trail-button
@tween-ui.title: Icon Trail Button
@tween-ui.description: A pill button whose icon pill expands on hover or focus, playing out a staggered chevron trail before it parks. CSS transitions and a small state machine — no animation library.

@tween-ui.name: sliding-tabs
@tween-ui.title: Sliding Tabs
@tween-ui.description: A pill nav whose lime indicator scales in under the first tab, then slides to follow the pointer or keyboard focus. Leaving the nav returns it to the active tab.

@tween-ui.name: avatar-reveal
@tween-ui.title: Avatar Reveal
@tween-ui.description: Three stacked avatars that scale and unblur in from the left on an elastic ease, then a caption slides in from the right.

@tween-ui.name: auth-modal
@tween-ui.title: Auth Modal
@tween-ui.description: A login modal: the backdrop fades, the panel scales up, then the close button, title, sign-in providers and email field stagger in. Closing plays the sequence in reverse.

@tween-ui.name: number-counter
@tween-ui.title: Number Counter
@tween-ui.description: An animated stats counter whose digits spin up once when the stat scrolls into view. ScrollTrigger fires it, Number Flow handles the count.

@tween-ui.name: voice-sample-player
@tween-ui.title: Voice Sample Player
@tween-ui.description: An audio player pill: press play and the name slides away, a lime waveform equalizer slides in and starts oscillating, and the icon morphs to pause. Pass a src to play real audio.

@tween-ui.name: flip-card
@tween-ui.title: Flip Card
@tween-ui.description: A card that flips in 3D on hover or tap — the front rotates out while the back rotates in with its description, feature list and CTA staggering into place.

@tween-ui.name: faq-accordion
@tween-ui.title: FAQ Accordion
@tween-ui.description: A single-open accordion that animates its height open while the answer reveals line by line through a SplitText mask and the icon morphs from plus to minus.

@tween-ui.name: shiny-button
@tween-ui.title: Shiny Button
@tween-ui.description: A pill button with a diagonal light sweep that glides across on hover while the leading sparkle twinkles. Pure CSS — no GSAP dependency.

@tween-ui.name: text-roll-button
@tween-ui.title: Text Roll Button
@tween-ui.description: A pill button whose label rolls up character by character on hover — the current text lifts out the top as a fresh copy rolls in from below, on a fine per-character stagger.

@tween-ui.name: slide-arrow-button
@tween-ui.title: Slide Arrow Button
@tween-ui.description: A pill button whose label rolls up on hover while the chevron slides out of its lime badge and a fresh one slides in from the left. Pure CSS — no GSAP dependency.

@tween-ui.name: glow-button
@tween-ui.title: Glow Button
@tween-ui.description: A pill button floating over a soft red, amber, violet and cyan glow that sharpens as the button lifts and a chevron slides through its slot. Pure CSS — no GSAP dependency.

@tween-ui.name: logo-orbit
@tween-ui.title: Logo Orbit
@tween-ui.description: Logos spaced evenly around a ring that rotates continuously, each mark counter-rotated so it always stays upright. Hover pauses the orbit.

@tween-ui.name: logo-cycle
@tween-ui.title: Logo Cycle
@tween-ui.description: A logo row that holds a fixed count and cycles the extras: the current set staggers up and blurs out as the next slides in from below. Hover pauses the loop.

@tween-ui.name: logo-wave
@tween-ui.title: Logo Wave
@tween-ui.description: An endless logo strip where the mark nearest the midpoint rises and scales up while its neighbors step down into a wave. Hover pauses the marquee.

@tween-ui.name: image-fan-slider
@tween-ui.title: Image Fan Slider
@tween-ui.description: An image gallery slider: a fan of photos that auto-advances — the active one large and sharp, its neighbors rotated and blurred on each side. Hover pauses. Pure CSS transitions.

@tween-ui.name: morphing-text
@tween-ui.title: Morphing Text
@tween-ui.description: A headline text animation whose last word cycles through a list with a gooey blur morph — an SVG alpha threshold fuses the outgoing and incoming words into one liquid shape while the slot eases between word widths.

@tween-ui.name: wordmark-reveal
@tween-ui.title: Wordmark Reveal
@tween-ui.description: A display wordmark text reveal that assembles itself on the first scroll — every letter turns in on its own vertical axis, then a script line leans in along the baseline. A cue holds the screen until you answer it, or it plays on mount with `instant`. ScrollTrigger and SplitText.

@tween-ui.name: pricing-plan-switch
@tween-ui.title: Pricing Plan Switch
@tween-ui.description: A pricing section where picking a plan morphs the name badge, crossfades the description and spins the price with Number Flow, while the checklist lights up its included rows. A monthly/yearly toggle re-spins the price.

@tween-ui.name: process-card-reveal
@tween-ui.title: Process Card Reveal
@tween-ui.description: Numbered steps on a timeline whose connector fills before the next card slides and blurs into place — image one way, copy the other. Hover pauses the loop; clicking a step jumps there.

@tween-ui.name: process-sticky-steps
@tween-ui.title: Process Sticky Steps
@tween-ui.description: A process block whose heading, divider and step numbers stay sticky inside the section while the cards scroll past them. No GSAP — just Intersection Observer.

@tween-ui.name: strip-wipe
@tween-ui.title: Strip Wipe
@tween-ui.description: A split testimonial slider whose photo wipes in as tiled strips beside the quote, the index ticking over on Number Flow. Prev and next reverse the wipe direction.

@tween-ui.name: rating-carousel
@tween-ui.title: Rating Carousel
@tween-ui.description: A Swiper testimonial row of rating cards: drag or swipe it, and off-window cards fade and blur as they leave. Autoplay pauses on hover, and dots jump to a card.

@tween-ui.name: cta-image-fan
@tween-ui.title: CTA Image Fan
@tween-ui.description: A call-to-action with a fanned photo stack auto-advancing above the headline and a shiny button below. Built from Image Fan Slider and Shiny Button.

@tween-ui.name: cta-photo-headline
@tween-ui.title: CTA Photo Headline
@tween-ui.description: A call-to-action where avatars pop in above a heading with two photos tucked into the copy — a pill that grows from the left, then a tilted square that drops into place.

@tween-ui.name: blog-hover-expand
@tween-ui.title: Blog Hover Expand
@tween-ui.description: A three-post blog row where the hovered card grows wider, its photo scales and tilts, and the title draws an underline. Pure CSS.

@tween-ui.name: integration-hub
@tween-ui.title: Integration Hub
@tween-ui.description: A hub-and-spoke integrations diagram: the center pops in, paths draw out to six logos, then a dot travels each line. Uses MotionPathPlugin.

@tween-ui.name: infinite-rotating-cards
@tween-ui.title: Infinite Rotating Cards
@tween-ui.description: A hero wheel of photo cards set on a large circle so only the top arc shows, spinning slowly so the next idea always comes into view.

@tween-ui.name: card-hover-expand
@tween-ui.title: Card Hover Expand
@tween-ui.description: A card row where the hovered card grows wider, its photo fades in and the title drops to the bottom over a gradient. Every card stays expanded on small screens. Pure CSS.

@tween-ui.name: card-spotlight-grid
@tween-ui.title: Card Spotlight Grid
@tween-ui.description: A staggered project grid — tile heights cycle every six cards — where the hovered tile tilts toward the cursor in 3D while its siblings scale back and dim. Pointer-only.

@tween-ui.name: column-drift
@tween-ui.title: Column Drift
@tween-ui.description: Three columns of review cards that swing in from the sides as the section scrolls, then drift past each other at different speeds. Cards lift on hover with an underline wipe. GSAP + ScrollTrigger.

@tween-ui.name: team-scatter-focus
@tween-ui.title: Team Scatter Focus
@tween-ui.description: A scattered team collage whose cards each fly in from their own direction, then blur and shrink back from whichever one you hover. Falls back to a stacked grid below lg.

@tween-ui.name: tab-wipe
@tween-ui.title: Tab Wipe
@tween-ui.description: A centered screenshot stage that wipes between slides on a clip-path edge while the incoming shot settles out of a slight scale and drift. The thumbnail strip is a real tablist, and the stage autoplays between clicks.

@tween-ui.name: logo-wall-shuffle
@tween-ui.title: Logo Wall Shuffle
@tween-ui.description: An integrations wall of staggered logo tiles where one mark at a time lifts away and the next rises in behind it. Every tile is visited before any repeats, and the loop pauses off-screen and in background tabs.

@tween-ui.name: testimonial-line-sweep
@tween-ui.title: Testimonial Line Sweep
@tween-ui.description: A paged testimonial pair whose text sweeps out line by line behind masks while the portrait irises shut, then the next quote arrives the same way. Pages with buttons or arrow keys. GSAP + SplitText.

@tween-ui.name: cta-starfall
@tween-ui.title: CTA Starfall
@tween-ui.description: A dark call-to-action section under a slow field of drifting stars lit by a violet bloom. The field is full on the first frame rather than spawning over time, and pauses off-screen and in background tabs.

@tween-ui.name: pricing-usage-slider
@tween-ui.title: Pricing Usage Slider
@tween-ui.description: A two-plan pricing section where the second card prices itself from a volume slider, the figure spinning with Number Flow as you drag while the track fills behind the handle.

@tween-ui.name: grid-cascade
@tween-ui.title: Grid Cascade
@tween-ui.description: A three-up testimonial grid that pages a whole set at a time — the current cards drop away on a stagger, then the next set cascades in from above, so the two never overlap mid-flight.

@tween-ui.name: cube-roll-item
@tween-ui.title: Cube Roll Item
@tween-ui.description: A numbered section index where each row is a 3D drum that rolls a quarter turn onto a filled face on hover. The roll follows the pointer — in from the top rolls down, out through the bottom keeps rolling down — while the rules draw in on load.

@tween-ui.name: shutter-slider
@tween-ui.title: Shutter Slider
@tween-ui.description: An autoplaying feature slider. Each image opens through vertical slats that alternate from the top and bottom, the headline letters roll in like drum faces, copy lines rise through masks and the caption pulls into focus — all mirrored when you travel back.

@tween-ui.name: testimonial-reel-focus
@tween-ui.title: Testimonial Reel Focus
@tween-ui.description: A reel of testimonial cards wider than the window, run sideways by vertical page scroll from inside a sticky stage. Each card rises as it crosses in, so scrolling sends a swell along the row; a tick strip reads the run back like a scrubber, and hovering a card pulls it into focus

@tweenly.name: fade-in
@tweenly.title: Fade In
@tweenly.description: Scroll-triggered fade with direction, distance, easing, scale and blur options.

@tweenly.name: text-reveal
@tweenly.title: Text Reveal
@tweenly.description: Word-by-word or character-by-character reveal with blur and stagger.

@tweenly.name: typewriter
@tweenly.title: Typewriter
@tweenly.description: Types and deletes a list of phrases with a blinking cursor.

@tweenly.name: word-rotate
@tweenly.title: Word Rotate
@tweenly.description: Cycles through words with slide, fade, blur or flip transitions.

@tweenly.name: shimmer-text
@tweenly.title: Shimmer Text
@tweenly.description: A light band that sweeps across text on a loop.

@tweenly.name: number-ticker
@tweenly.title: Number Ticker
@tweenly.description: Counts up to a value when scrolled into view, with formatting options.

@tweenly.name: fill-button
@tweenly.title: Fill Button
@tweenly.description: Hover/focus button with a GSAP clip-path fill sweep. Configurable direction, duration and ease.

@tweenly.name: magnetic
@tweenly.title: Magnetic
@tweenly.description: Wrap anything to make it drift toward the cursor on a spring.

@tweenly.name: tilt-card
@tweenly.title: Tilt Card
@tweenly.description: 3D perspective tilt that follows the pointer, with optional glare.

@tweenly.name: spotlight-card
@tweenly.title: Spotlight Card
@tweenly.description: Card with a radial spotlight and glowing border that track the cursor.

@tweenly.name: stagger
@tweenly.title: Stagger
@tweenly.description: Reveals its children one after another as they enter the viewport.

@tweenly.name: marquee
@tweenly.title: Marquee
@tweenly.description: Infinite, seamless scrolling row or column of content.

@tweenly.name: sticky-cards
@tweenly.title: Sticky Cards
@tweenly.description: A stack of same-size cards pinned on scroll. The front card lifts away, then the next, one by one.

@tweenly.name: scroll-text-reveal
@tweenly.title: Scroll Text Reveal
@tweenly.description: Pins the section and reveals text word by word as you scroll; the page resumes once the reveal completes.

@tweenly.name: horizontal-scroll
@tweenly.title: Horizontal Scroll
@tweenly.description: Pins a row of images and scrolls it sideways with the page, then releases to normal scroll.

@tweenly.name: image-reveal
@tweenly.title: Image Reveal
@tweenly.description: Images fly in from their own direction as they scroll into view.

@tweenly.name: ascii-image
@tweenly.title: ASCII Image
@tweenly.description: Renders any image as ASCII art on a canvas, with a glittering pixel trail under the cursor.

@tweenly.name: hover-media
@tweenly.title: Hover Media
@tweenly.description: Inline keyword that reveals a floating image or video that follows the cursor.

@tweenly.name: cursor
@tweenly.title: Cursor
@tweenly.description: Custom cursors: ring, dot, blend, crosshair, sparkle trail, sunflower and rose.

@tweenly.name: loader
@tweenly.title: Loader
@tweenly.description: Three loading animations: bouncing dots, equalizer bars and an orbit spinner.

@tweenly.name: download-button
@tweenly.title: Download Button
@tweenly.description: Button that morphs from Download to a live progress fill and a drawn check mark.

@tweenly.name: image-fan
@tweenly.title: Image Fan
@tweenly.description: One image rises from below, then the rest slide out from under it into an overlapping fan.

@tweenly.name: image-arc
@tweenly.title: Image Arc
@tweenly.description: Images on a half-circle wheel that turns on its own or with the scroll.

@tweenly.name: expand-gallery
@tweenly.title: Expand Gallery
@tweenly.description: A row of small thumbnails where each one grows large in turn as you scroll.

@tweenly.name: scroll-focus
@tweenly.title: Scroll Focus
@tweenly.description: A column of images where the one in the center grows, with a title list that stays in sync.

@tweenly.name: shine-button
@tweenly.title: Shine Button
@tweenly.description: Pill button with a light beam circling its edge and a soft sheen on hover.

@tweenly.name: ripple-button
@tweenly.title: Ripple Button
@tweenly.description: Material-style ripples that expand from the exact point you press.

@tweenly.name: hold-button
@tweenly.title: Hold Button
@tweenly.description: Press and hold to confirm destructive actions. A fill sweeps across while held.

@tweenly.name: slide-button
@tweenly.title: Slide Button
@tweenly.description: Slide-to-confirm track with a draggable knob, shimmering label and keyboard support.

@tweenly.name: like-button
@tweenly.title: Like Button
@tweenly.description: Heart toggle with a spring pop, ring burst, particles and a rolling counter.

@tweenly.name: segmented-control
@tweenly.title: Segmented Control
@tweenly.description: Tabs with a springy pill that slides behind the active option, with arrow-key navigation.

@tweenly.name: number-stepper
@tweenly.title: Number Stepper
@tweenly.description: Minus / plus stepper whose digits roll individually, with hold-to-repeat and a shake at the limits.

@tweenly.name: elastic-switch
@tweenly.title: Elastic Switch
@tweenly.description: Toggle whose knob stretches while pressed and springs across with overshoot, with optional sun / moon icons.

@tweenly.name: expand-input
@tweenly.title: Expand Input
@tweenly.description: A pill button that morphs into an email field, then a spinner and a drawn check on submit.

@tweenly.name: rating
@tweenly.title: Rating
@tweenly.description: Star rating with a sweeping hover fill, half stars, and a springy pop with sparkles on select.

@tweenly.name: navbar
@tweenly.title: Navbar
@tweenly.description: Five minimal, animated navigation bars: glass pill, scroll morph, sliding underline, dynamic island mega-menu and full-screen overlay.

@tweenly.name: table-of-contents
@tweenly.title: Table of Contents
@tweenly.description: Scroll-synced "On This Page" sidebar with a plane that flies along the heading trail, a sliding rail, or a spotlight list.

@tweenly.name: otp-input
@tweenly.title: OTP Input
@tweenly.description: Verification code input with springy digits, a gliding focus ring and animated success and error states.

@tweenly.name: chart-line
@tweenly.title: Chart Line
@tweenly.description: Multi-series line and area chart from plain row data, with draw-in lines, halftone fills, a snapping crosshair tooltip and a toggleable legend.

@tweenly.name: chart-progress
@tweenly.title: Chart Progress
@tweenly.description: Progress toward a real target: a wavy, grainy fill over a hatched remainder, with a thermometer marker, quota line and stacked segments.

@tweenly.name: chart-radial
@tweenly.title: Chart Radial
@tweenly.description: Donut, pie or gauge from your rows with sweep-in slices, legend toggling with re-flow, hover explode and a live center total.

@tweenly.name: chart-dots
@tweenly.title: Chart Dots
@tweenly.description: Dot matrix of filled versus hatched units with a partial last dot, spring wave in fill order, and a huge count-up figure.

@tweenly.name: preloader
@tweenly.title: Preloader
@tweenly.description: Full-screen loader with a counting percentage and rotating quotes that reveals the page at 100%.

@tweenly.name: chart-bar
@tweenly.title: Chart Bar
@tweenly.description: Grouped or stacked bar chart, vertical or horizontal, with springy staggered growth, textured series, hover highlight and a toggleable legend.

@tweenly.name: chart-rings
@tweenly.title: Chart Rings

@uicapsule.name: voxel-landing
@uicapsule.title: Voxel Landing
@uicapsule.description: Isometric voxel diorama landing page — scroll pans diagonally through a living world of walkers, marquee signs, and ground-laid typography
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: material-you-theming
@uicapsule.title: Material You Theming
@uicapsule.description: Material You dynamic color — pick a wallpaper and a tonal palette derived from its seed hue re-themes the whole system.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: diffusion-reveal
@uicapsule.title: Diffusion Reveal
@uicapsule.description: The image-gen loading ritual done honestly — pure noise resolves through coarse color blobs into the sharp frame, the way a denoiser actually converges.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: circle-to-search
@uicapsule.title: Circle to Search
@uicapsule.description: Android's Circle to Search — enter search mode, lasso anything with a glowing stroke, and results slide up for the circled item.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: jiggle-mode
@uicapsule.title: Jiggle Mode
@uicapsule.description: iOS home-screen edit mode — long-press to wobble, drag to reorder, tap the badge to remove.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: predictive-back
@uicapsule.title: Predictive Back
@uicapsule.description: Android's predictive back gesture — drag from the edge and the screen shrinks in your hand, revealing where you'll land before you commit.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: drum-picker
@uicapsule.title: Drum Picker
@uicapsule.description: The iOS time-picker wheel on the web — 3D cylinder, momentum flicks, detent snapping, edge fog.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: vibe-dial
@uicapsule.title: Vibe Dial
@uicapsule.description: A temperature knob for generation — turn it and the dial itself heats up: the LED ring fills from cool blue to ember, the glow swells, and the readout drifts from precise to unhinged.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: screenshot-capture
@uicapsule.title: Screenshot Capture
@uicapsule.description: The iOS screenshot moment — flash, the screen shrinks into a corner thumbnail, lingers, then swipes away.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: seek-filmstrip
@uicapsule.title: Seek Filmstrip
@uicapsule.description: The tvOS scrubber — dragging the timeline raises a filmstrip of preview frames above the playhead, rendered live from a synthetic day-cycle video.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: context-menu-peek
@uicapsule.title: Context Menu Peek
@uicapsule.description: iOS long-press context menu — the bubble lifts, the thread melts into blur, and the menu springs from the press point.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: editorial-charts
@uicapsule.title: Editorial Charts
@uicapsule.description: A four-card editorial chart set — rung bars, a hairline dot-line, a tick-ring dial, and a dot waffle — drawn ink-on-paper by TanStack Charts, with spring-staggered entrances and quarterly data that morphs on a loop.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: liquid-orb
@uicapsule.title: Liquid Orb
@uicapsule.description: Liquid-glass shader orb that morphs through material presets — siri, aurora, plasma, chrome, opal, blue drop, violet ember
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: widget-stack
@uicapsule.title: Widget Stack
@uicapsule.description: iOS Smart Stack — widgets roll through a vertical 3D page-flip, auto-advancing until you swipe.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: chibi-plants
@uicapsule.title: Chibi Plants
@uicapsule.description: Cute chibi potted plants raymarched from signed distance fields — they watch your cursor, blink, and morph between characters
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: pattern-unlock
@uicapsule.title: Pattern Unlock
@uicapsule.description: Android's 9-dot pattern lock — glowing trail, dot ripples, red shake on a wrong draw, green on unlock.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: airdrop-radar
@uicapsule.title: AirDrop Radar
@uicapsule.description: AirDrop's ripple radar — nearby people surface on expanding rings; tap one and a progress ring wraps their avatar.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: pip-window
@uicapsule.title: PiP Window
@uicapsule.description: iOS picture-in-picture — flick the call window and velocity picks its corner; throw it off an edge to tuck it behind a peek tab.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: paper-roll
@uicapsule.title: Paper Roll
@uicapsule.description: An endless strip of paper unrolls behind a heavy roll, printing a portfolio in its wake
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: desktop-os
@uicapsule.title: Desktop OS
@uicapsule.description: A desktop boots itself — one card riffles through every thumbnail, icons burst out from centre, then the dock magnifies under the cursor and windows drag, stack and pop.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: formation
@uicapsule.title: Formation
@uicapsule.description: Sixteen photo cards regroup between four spatial formations — a solved ellipse, an arc conveyor, a tilted ring and a swelling orbit — and scrub under drag or wheel with a parallax lean that follows the cursor.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: gravity-wall
@uicapsule.title: Gravity Wall
@uicapsule.description: A drifting wall of photos bends away from the cursor like a gravity well, promoting whichever picture sits in the clearing — click and the whole wall pans to bring it to center.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: lookbook-camera
@uicapsule.title: Lookbook Camera
@uicapsule.description: A camera drifts forever across an edgeless field of fashion figures — scroll to zoom at the cursor, drag to fling, click one and it flies in while every other card dims and a glass panel slides out.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: stat-reel
@uicapsule.title: Stat Reel
@uicapsule.description: An endless wheel of labels glides past a fixed center line while a giant gradient-filled figure swaps in beside it; scroll to seize the reel and it resumes on its own after four seconds.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: terminal-disintegrate
@uicapsule.title: Terminal Disintegrate
@uicapsule.description: An ASCII trading terminal drawn from box-drawing glyphs, whose screen burns into drifting embers and reassembles as the next one — scrub backwards and the same debris replays in reverse.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: volume-control
@uicapsule.title: Volume Control
@uicapsule.description: Five volume controls that refuse to just be a slider: tilt, cannon, curling, dot-matrix, and whack-a-mole.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: effort-picker
@uicapsule.title: Effort Picker
@uicapsule.description: Remake of the Codex effort picker, in ChatGPT's chrome or Claude's.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: tesla-climate
@uicapsule.title: Tesla Climate
@uicapsule.description: A replica of Tesla's climate screen — drag the airstream to aim the vents, with live temperature, fan, and seat-heat response.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: dynamic-ai-composer
@uicapsule.title: Dynamic AI Composer
@uicapsule.description: A shape-shifting AI input capsule that morphs between text, voice, thinking, and streaming states.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: dynamic-island
@uicapsule.title: Dynamic Island
@uicapsule.description: A springy Dynamic Island interaction with ring and timer states.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: geometric-orb
@uicapsule.title: Geometric Orb
@uicapsule.description: 3D animated spherical orb with flowing latitude lines and depth-based opacity
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: gradient-orb
@uicapsule.title: Gradient Orb
@uicapsule.description: Glowing shader orb with noise-based color mixing, hue rotation, and breathing pulse
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: wireframe-orb
@uicapsule.title: Wireframe Orb
@uicapsule.description: Curl-noise-displaced particle cloud rendered as a continuous line strip with bloom
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: spinner-pixel-grid
@uicapsule.title: Spinner Pixel Grid
@uicapsule.description: Dot-matrix pixel loading spinners — 20 grid animations (wave, spiral, radar, rain, snake, heart…) with square or round dots, neon glow and rainbow hue cycling.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: sidebar
@uicapsule.title: Resizable Sidebar
@uicapsule.description: A shadcn-inspired application sidebar with a draggable resize handle.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: voice-dictator
@uicapsule.title: Voice Dictator
@uicapsule.description: Voice dictation UI — tap the orb and a dithered WebGL ring swells with simulated speech amplitude while a faux transcript streams in word by word.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: emerald-template
@uicapsule.title: Emerald
@uicapsule.description: Dark emerald AI landing page template — hero demo types a question, reveals collapsible chain-of-thought steps and a sourced answer; feature cards, integrations marquee.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: spreadsheet
@uicapsule.title: Spreadsheet
@uicapsule.description: Spreadsheet data grid with AI enrichment — select cells, hit Enrich and each fills in after a Generating… beat; editable cells, drag/shift selection, arrow keys, resizable columns.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: filter-bar
@uicapsule.title: Filter Bar
@uicapsule.description: Data table filter bar — build text, number, date and option filters as editable chips with operators, or type a prompt, hit Ask AI and watch simulated filters stream in.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: tooltip-grid
@uicapsule.title: Tooltip Grid
@uicapsule.description: Tooltip with a direction aware pixel grid background animation
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: carousel-3d
@uicapsule.title: 3D Carousel
@uicapsule.description: WebGPU 3D image carousel — cards ride a bent ring; scroll or drag to spin it with momentum, then it snaps to the nearest card as side cards fade back.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: snail-timer
@uicapsule.title: Snail Timer
@uicapsule.description: Fastest countdown ever
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: ascii-renderer
@uicapsule.title: ASCII Renderer
@uicapsule.description: Take any 3D model and render it as ASCII art
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: background-pixel-stars
@uicapsule.title: Background Pixel Stars
@uicapsule.description: Retro 16fps pixel starfield background — grid-snapped stars twinkle in stepped fades and slowly reshuffle while pixel shooting stars streak past with fading trails.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: background-shapes
@uicapsule.title: Background Shapes
@uicapsule.description: Generative glyph grid background — two mirrored SVG panels of dots, crosses, stripes and squares, each cell swapping to a random shape on its own timer.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: card-stack
@uicapsule.title: Scrollable Card Stack
@uicapsule.description: An infinite stack of cards placed with perspective one on top of another.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: infinite-grid
@uicapsule.title: Infinite Grid
@uicapsule.description: Infinite pannable grid — drag or scroll with momentum through endless cells, indexed in a spiral out from the center and rendered only while in view.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: ios-volume-slider
@uicapsule.title: iOS Volume Slider
@uicapsule.description: iOS-style vertical volume slider — drag past the top and the bar stretches, past the bottom it squashes, with sigmoid rubber-band resistance and a spring back.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: light-dark-toggle
@uicapsule.title: Light/Dark Toggle
@uicapsule.description: Sun/moon light-dark theme toggle icon — the moon's crescent mask slides away as it shrinks into a sun, the icon rotates, and six rays pop in one by one.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: like-button
@uicapsule.title: Like Button
@uicapsule.description: Twitter style like button
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: particle-orb
@uicapsule.title: Particle Orb
@uicapsule.description: Noise-displaced particle sphere with additive-blended dots and custom vertex shader
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>

@uicapsule.name: radial-slider
@uicapsule.title: Radial Slider
@uicapsule.description: Rotary dial slider — drag sideways to spin a ring of tick marks under a fixed needle; release and it springs to the nearest tick while the number readout rolls.
@uicapsule.author: Kaiyu Hsu <uicapsule@kyh.io>
